items.title: 中國旺旺被曝要裁員1,000人 要求員工反思
items.title_en: China Want Want Exposed for Planning 1,000 Layoffs, Demanding Staff Self‑Reflection
paras: 本月上旬，中國旺旺集團董事長蔡衍明發布的內部信不脛而走，蔡衍明在信中稱公司遇到了「重大經營危機」，且要淘汰沒有貢獻的幹部。消息一出，引發公眾與行業對旺旺集團的廣泛討論。
多名接近旺旺集團的人士透露，集團在近期採取了裁員計畫。一名離職員工表示，他聽說集團計劃的裁員目標是1,000人左右，目前已經裁員約400人。
據《財新》21日（上周五）報導，另一名離職員工說，其所在部門計劃砍掉8%員工，這意味著約有近20人被裁。
此外，多名員工稱，旺旺集團近期要求員工撰寫自評報告，「這是第一次公司因為淨利潤大幅下滑，讓所有員工來反思，」一名接近旺旺的人士說。
具體而言，旺旺集團要求總部全體人員必須針對過去一年實際結果，展開「確實認識自己•切實反思自己」的回顧，但單位最高主管無需參與。
集團要求，員工自評報告應該秉持「確實認識自己、切實反思自己、隨時提醒自己、篤實把握自己、絕對發揮自己」的原則，「真實、客觀地剖析自己的不足」，且要「以事實為依據、數據為支撐」。
員工自評後，由直屬主管（N+1）、隔級主管（N+2）按回顧表所列維度逐項評分，評分鏈條最高至單位最高主管。
日前中國旺旺一封內部公開信在網上流傳，蔡衍明將集團2026年度第一季業績失速直接定性為「重大經營危機」，直言「我們靠著幾個拳頭產品過了近30年的好日子，一直未能創新求變」、「今天的苦果，是過去幾年來因循怠惰所致」。
業績預告顯示，中國旺旺2026年度第一季（2026年4月1日至6月30日）收入較上年同期下降約6%，淨利潤銳減約38%。業績承壓之下，蔡衍明坦言沒有產出、沒有功勞的（旺旺人），都會被淘汰。
paras_en: In early this month, an internal letter from Cai Yanming, chairman of China Want Want Group, spread rapidly; in the letter Cai said the company faced a “major operational crisis” and would eliminate unproductive executives. The news sparked widespread discussion among the public and industry about Want Want Group.
Several sources close to the group disclosed that it has recently launched a layoff plan. A former employee said he heard the target is roughly 1,000 staff, and about 400 have already been let go.
According to Caixin on the 21st (last Friday), another former employee said his department plans to cut 8% of its workforce, meaning roughly 20 people would be dismissed.

In addition, multiple employees said Want Want has recently required staff to write self‑assessment reports, “the first time the company has asked all employees to reflect because net profit has dropped sharply,” said a source close to Want Want.

Specifically, the group requires every employee at headquarters to review the past year’s actual results and conduct a “truly know yourself · genuinely reflect on yourself” exercise, though the highest‑level unit supervisors are exempt.

The self‑assessment must follow the principles of “truly know yourself, genuinely reflect, constantly remind yourself, firmly grasp yourself, and fully unleash yourself,” and must “honestly and objectively analyze one’s shortcomings,” based on “facts and supported by data.”

After the self‑assessment, the employee’s direct supervisor (N+1) and the next‑level supervisor (N+2) score each dimension listed in the review form, with the scoring chain extending up to the unit’s top supervisor.

A recent internal open letter from China Want Want circulated online, in which Cai Yanming labeled the group’s sluggish Q1 2026 performance as a “major operational crisis,” bluntly stating, “We have lived on a few flagship products for nearly 30 years without innovation, and today’s bitter fruit is the result of years of complacency.”

The performance preview shows that for Q1 2026 (April 1 – June 30, 2026), Want Want’s revenue fell about 6% year‑on‑year and net profit plunged roughly 38%. Under this pressure, Cai admitted that any “Want Want people” without output or merit would be eliminated.

items.title: 《大賣空》貝瑞拋售阿里巴巴、稱「股價太貴」！轉手買入「這一股」
items.title_en: Michael Burry Sells Alibaba, Calls Its Stock Too Expensive, Switches to JD
paras: 以押注美國房市崩盤聞名的《大賣空》原型投資人貝瑞（Michael Burry）批評阿里巴巴(09988-HK) 股價估值過高，並透露自己近期已退出這家中國科技巨頭的持股，轉而在其競爭對手京東集團(09618-HK) 建立一筆「大額」持倉。
根據《彭博》報導，貝瑞在Substack發文表示，他原本計畫在一、兩個月後將大部分資金重新投入阿里巴巴，但如今已改變想法。他指出，除非阿里巴巴股價跌至目前的一半，否則他不會重新產生投資興趣。
貝瑞是Scion Capital Management創辦人，因在2008年全球金融危機前押注美國房市下跌而成名。
他此次發表上述看法之際，阿里巴巴才宣布計畫透過發行新股籌集約800億港元（約102億美元），為AI投資提供資金。若完成，這將成為香港市場有史以來規模最大的上市公司增發集資案。
對於阿里巴巴透過發行新股籌資的做法，貝瑞直言自己「我無法認同發行新股這件事」，並預期公司投入資本報酬率仍將持續下滑。
阿里巴巴近期公布截至6月底的季度財報，獲利較去年同期大幅下滑75%。隨著公司加大AI相關資本支出，進一步加劇了投資者對中國科技業未來回報的擔憂。
股價表現同樣承受壓力。阿里巴巴美國存託憑證(BABA-US) 今年以來累計下跌18.6%，僅上週五（21日）單日就下挫8.6%；在香港掛牌的阿里巴巴股價今年迄今也下跌13.9%。
值得注意的是，貝瑞今年4月才透露建立阿里巴巴的新持倉。
阿里巴巴則在週日（23日）另行宣布，此次增發新股的定價為每股112.70港元，相較之下，香港股市上週五收盤價為123港元。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Michael Burry, the original investor behind the book "The Big Short" known for betting on the collapse of the U.S. housing market, criticized Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. (09988-HK) for being overvalued and revealed that he has recently exited his holdings in the Chinese tech giant, instead building a large position in its competitor JD.com (09618-HK).

According to Bloomberg, Burry wrote on Substack that he had originally planned to reinvest most of his capital back into Alibaba in one or two months, but has now changed his mind. He said he would not be interested in re-entering the company unless its stock price fell to about half of its current level.
Burry is the founder of Scion Capital Management and became famous for betting on the decline of the U.S. housing market before the 2008 global financial crisis.

At the time Burry made these remarks, Alibaba had just announced plans to raise about HK$80 billion (US$10.2 billion) by issuing new shares to fund AI investments. If completed, it would be the largest share‑issuance capital‑raising deal ever in the Hong Kong market.
Regarding Alibaba’s new‑share issuance, Burry said, “I cannot endorse the act of issuing new shares,” and expects the company’s capital‑return rate to continue to decline.

Alibaba recently released its Q2 2024 earnings, showing a 75% drop in profit year‑on‑year. The company’s increased AI‑related capital expenditures have further heightened investors’ concerns about the future returns of Chinese technology firms.

The stock has also been under pressure. Alibaba’s U.S. Depositary Receipts (BABA‑US) have fallen 18.6% year‑to‑date, dropping 8.6% on Friday the 21st; the Hong Kong‑listed Alibaba shares have fallen 13.9% so far this year.
It is worth noting that Burry only disclosed his new Alibaba position in April of this year.
Alibaba announced on Sunday the 23rd that the new share issuance would be priced at HK$112.70 per share, compared with the Hong Kong market closing price of HK$123 on Friday.

items.title: 永虹先進三階段發展無人系統任務生態系 歐系軍工業到訪
items.title_en: Yonghong Advanced Expands UAV System Mission Ecosystem in Three Phases, Attracts European Defense Industry Visit
paras: 永虹先進(6618-TW)正擴大在無人機產業的布局，一口氣發表巡檢偵查無人機、六軸大型物流無人機和無人機VR模擬器三大產品與應用方案，吸引歐系軍工業者到訪交流。
永虹先進長期深耕航太級高階熱塑性碳纖維複合材料，南投新廠已取得AS9100D航太品質系統認證，近年也持續串聯國內無人機產業夥伴，其中，與台灣無人機燃油噴嘴大廠豐兆航太簽署共同開發採購合約意向書，雙方將就Cougar無人機展開共同開發、製造及市場拓展。
永虹先進表示，聚焦小型無人機「巡檢＋偵查」應用，依照規劃航線模擬於廠房及周邊環境執行巡檢任務，展示定點觀察、區域偵查、環境巡視及影像資訊蒐集等功能，驗證無人機於複雜場域快速取得第一線資訊的能力，可望進一步延伸至智慧巡檢、災害應變及安全監控等應用場域。
其次則鎖定六軸大型無人機物流運輸應用，現場完整呈現貨物裝載、指定地點起飛、空中運輸、航線飛行、指定區域降落至物資交付等任務流程，將大型無人機由單純展示載重能力，進一步導入實際物流任務情境，未來可望應用於偏遠地區運補、緊急物資配送及災害救援等特殊運輸需求。
永虹先進也強調全台首創的「VR無人機維修模擬暨多旋翼、定翼機考照與評分系統」，除提供飛行模擬，更將無人機維修學習、零組件辨識、操作程序、考照模擬及學習評量導入沉浸式虛擬環境，可望應用於學校與教育單位、考照機構、企業與產業培訓，以及政府、國防與救災單位等場域，透過虛擬環境反覆訓練，降低實機操作風險及訓練成本，並建立標準化的無人機教育與評量模式。
永虹先進期透過不同的產品定位，串聯成逐步成形的無人系統任務生態系，前端由小型無人機負責偵查、巡檢及資訊蒐集，中段透過大型物流無人機執行物資運送及補給，後端則由VR系統負責操作人員訓練、維修教育、能力評量和人才培育，推動公司由航太先進材料供應商朝無人機整合型解決方案業者發展。
paras_en: Yonghong Advanced (6618‑TW) is expanding its footprint in the UAV industry by announcing three new products and application solutions in a single press release: a patrol‑inspection UAV, a six‑axis large‑scale logistics UAV, and a UAV VR simulator, drawing European defense industry visitors for discussion.

Yonghong Advanced has long focused on aerospace‑grade high‑performance thermoplastic carbon‑fiber composites. Its new Nantou plant has obtained AS9100D aerospace quality system certification, and in recent years it has continued to link domestic UAV partners. Notably, it signed a joint development and procurement memorandum of intent with Taiwan’s major UAV fuel nozzle manufacturer, Fengzhao Aerospace, to jointly develop, manufacture, and market the Cougar UAV.

Yonghong Advanced says it is focusing on small UAV “patrol‑inspection” applications. According to its plan, the UAV will simulate flight routes in the factory and surrounding environment to perform inspection tasks, demonstrating point observation, area reconnaissance, environmental surveillance, and image data collection. This validates the UAV’s ability to quickly acquire frontline information in complex settings and could be extended to smart inspection, disaster response, and security monitoring.

Next, the company targets a six‑axis large UAV for logistics transport. The demonstration showcased the full mission flow: loading cargo, taking off from a designated location, air transport, flight path, and landing in a specified area for delivery. This moves the large UAV from merely demonstrating payload capacity to real logistics scenarios, with future applications in remote area supply, emergency delivery, and disaster relief special transport needs.

Yonghong Advanced also highlighted Taiwan’s first VR UAV maintenance simulation and multi‑rotor/ fixed‑wing certification and scoring system. Beyond flight simulation, it incorporates UAV maintenance learning, component identification, operating procedures, certification simulation, and learning assessment into an immersive virtual environment. This can be used by schools, training institutions, certification bodies, enterprises, industry training, and government, defense, and disaster relief units, reducing real‑aircraft operation risk and training costs while establishing a standardized UAV education and assessment model.

Through different product positioning, Yonghong Advanced aims to link together a gradually forming UAV system mission ecosystem: front‑end small UAVs handle reconnaissance, patrol, and information gathering; mid‑segment large logistics UAVs perform material transport and resupply; back‑end VR systems train operators, educate maintenance, assess capabilities, and cultivate talent, driving the company’s evolution from an aerospace advanced material supplier to an integrated UAV solution provider.

items.title: 800億港元配股+《大賣空》原型清倉施壓  阿里巴巴今港股早盤崩逾9%
items.title_en: Alibaba Shares Drop Over 9% in Hong Kong Opening Amid 80 Billion HKD Rights Issue and Pressure from 'The Big Short' Protagonist
paras: 阿里巴巴今(24)日在港股大幅開低逾9%，開盤報每股113.1港元，最低來到110.8港元，主要受到發行新股計畫，以及遭到市場知名投資人大幅清倉的影響。
阿里巴巴在週末期間宣布，打算以每股112.70港元的價格配售7.1億股新股份，募資總額約800億港元(約合102億美元)，扣除佣金及相關開支後，配售所得淨額約797億港元，將100%用於AI基礎設施建設和總成本
配售價較阿里巴巴上週五(21日)港股收盤價折讓約8.4%，為阿里巴巴2019年在香港上市以來首次進行股權配售。
市場人士分析，短期籌碼供給增加疊加折價定價，料將持續壓抑股價表現，週三(26日)交割完成前，配售價附近或成為多空激戰戰場。
本次新股配售對象為美國境外的非美國專業及法人機構，所得款項淨額將100%用於投資全棧AI能力與基礎建設。
不過，知名投資人、電影《大賣空》原型Michael Burry認為，阿里巴巴股票估值過高，並透露最近清倉這家中國科技巨頭的股份，轉而大幅增持京東。
Burry週日(23日)在Substack上貼文說：「我原本打算一、兩個月後將大部分資金移回阿里，但現在不會了。阿里巴巴股價必須下跌一半，我才會重新感興趣。」
paras_en: Alibaba opened more than 9% lower in Hong Kong today (24), trading at HK$113.1 per share at the open and falling to a low of HK$110.8, largely due to the announcement of a new share issuance and the large-scale liquidation by a well-known market investor.

During the weekend, Alibaba announced plans to issue 710 million new shares at HK$112.70 each, raising roughly HK$80 billion (about US$10.2 billion). After fees and related expenses, the net proceeds are expected to be about HK$79.7 billion, which will be used 100% for AI infrastructure and overall costs.
The offering price is about 8.4% below Alibaba's closing price on Friday (21), marking the first equity rights issue since Alibaba's 2019 listing in Hong Kong.

Market analysts say that the short-term increase in supply combined with the discounted pricing will likely continue to suppress the stock price, and that the price range around the offering price could become a battleground for buyers and sellers before settlement on Wednesday (26).

The new shares are being offered to non-U.S. professional and institutional investors outside the United States, and the net proceeds will be used 100% to invest in full-stack AI capabilities and infrastructure.

However, well-known investor and the inspiration for the film "The Big Short," Michael Burry, believes Alibaba's valuation is too high and has disclosed that he has recently liquidated his holdings in the Chinese tech giant, instead increasing his stake in JD.com.

Burry wrote on Substack on Sunday (23): "I originally planned to move most of my money back into Alibaba in one or two months, but I won't do that now. Alibaba's stock price has to drop by half before I become interested again."

items.title: 美加關稅談判破局 凌晨1點！川普發飆了
paras: 您沒看錯，周日（23日）凌晨1點，美國總統川普還沒有睡，向加拿大開炮了。
川普在社交平台發洩不滿：「加拿大想享受（作為美國）一個州的好處，卻又不願成為美國的一個州！！！多年來，他們還對我國偉大農民徵收巨額關稅。夠了！！！」
短短一句話，六個感嘆號！
看了一下，具體發布時間，凌晨1:06。
日理萬機的川普，久久不能入睡。
長夜，最容易滋生不加掩飾的情緒，螢幕一端的一句怒吼，牽動的卻是兩個國家間戲劇性博弈。
美國不想姑息了，對加拿大，就是要加徵沉重關稅，就是要讓加拿大成為美國第51個州。
第二天醒來，具體時間，上午9:11，川普又重發了一遍上面這條推文。
總統先生的怒氣，且沒消呢。
反覆重申的言辭，既是對外施壓，也是對內表明立場，情緒背後藏著清晰談判籌碼。
加拿大那邊，情緒更加悲憤。
加拿大總理卡尼此前宣布，撤回與美國的談判，因為「美國要求太多，給的太少」；至於美國加徵50%關稅，加拿大以牙還牙，「1美元對1美元」。
為什麼加拿大不願意談了？
應該是美加談得差不多的時候，美國又突然加碼了：
1，要求加拿大接受對第三國貿易的限制，也就是說，加拿大以後與誰簽署貿易協議，美國說了算；
2，要求擁有對加拿大礦產資源出售掌控權，也就是說，加拿大礦產賣給誰，也是美國說了算。
這還怎麼談？
答應了，加拿大就不再是一個獨立國家了。更何況，美國的要求，總是一再加碼。
談判底線一旦被不斷突破，妥協就不再是和解，而是一步步交出主權。
綜合加拿大媒體的報導，美國對加拿大的核心要求，不止於上面兩條，應該是13條，大致如下：
1.對戰略性基礎設施合作擁有否決權
加拿大必須將基礎設施領域（港口、電信、能源管道、電網）的重大外資項目提交美加聯合審查委員會，這相當於讓美國對加拿大境內外資投資擁有實際否決權。
2.預先對非美國國家實施貿易限制
加拿大必須配合美國實施制裁、出口管制，並對第三國徵收進口關稅，放棄制定獨立對外貿易政策的權利。
3.關鍵礦產領域司法管轄權優先
美國要求對加拿大北部出產的所有未精煉關鍵礦產（例如鋰、鎳、鈷、鈾）享有優先購買權，並鎖定定價，限制加拿大本土加工，同時限制向其他國家出口。
4.廢除數位服務稅與《在線新聞法案》
加拿大必須撤銷相關法案：該法案原本要求境外科技平台針對加拿大用戶產生的營收納稅，並向加拿大新聞出版商支付補償。
5.取消文化與語言保護政策
美方要求廢除加拿大內容配額制度（加制內容配額）、修訂《在線流媒體法案》，免除美國商品及數字服務需遵守各省語言法規的義務，目標直指魁北克的法語保護政策。
6.廢除 「加拿大優先」 公共採購規則
加拿大各級政府必須給予美國企業平等參與公共基建項目投標的資格，禁止優待本土或加拿大供應商。
7.拆除農業保護保障機制
美國要求加拿大取消乳製品、蛋類、家禽行業的供應管理體系，強制採用美國化學品與農藥標準。
8.單方面修改汽車行業相關規則
重型整車廠及汽車零部件行業不再享受關稅減免；同時修改相關規則，促使整車製造崗位轉移至美國本土。
9.延長醫藥專利保護期限
美國要求延長境外藥企的數據獨佔保護期，推遲仿製藥在加拿大上市，推高各省醫療開支。
10.加拿大能源優先供給美國

items.title: 鑽針廠尖點科技籌資急 擬以發行無擔保CB+辦現增籌資逾16.8億元
items.title_en: Jiantian Technology Urgently Raises Capital, Plans to Issue Unsecured Convertible Bonds and Cash-Add Shares Over 1.68 Billion NTD
paras: AI需求旺盛，PCB 鑽針及代鑽服務廠尖點科技 (8021-TW)在鑽針開新產能的規劃上，也積極衝刺因應市場需求，同時，尖點科技並送件金管會將以發行現增股及發行可轉換公司債(CB)進行市場籌資合計逾16.8億元。
尖點科技送件擬辦理發行4.8億元面額無擔保可轉換公司債並加上發行現金增資股4000張，以暫訂以300元發行，籌資12億元，兩者合計進行市場籌資合計逾16.8億元。兩者的主辦券商爲福邦證券(6026-TW)。
尖點科技在PCB鑽針產能正在擴充預計今年底達每月4500萬支，2027年規劃達成7000萬支，到2028年達到月產能9000萬支的目標，同時代鑽孔的設備數量也將再逐年提升。同時，尖點科技2026年上半年的資本支出金額爲13.8億元，林若萍指出，規劃2026年全年的資本支出將達30億元。
尖點科技的鑽針產能擴充案，預計到今年底達每月4500萬支，如依規劃在2027年底達成每月7000萬支鑽針的產能，等於較今年底的產能再增加55.56%，到2028年的底鑽針每月產能將較今年成長1倍。
尖點科技2026年第二季財報營收18.26億元，毛利率41.78%，季增5.19個百分點，年增12.34個百分點，單季稅後純益3.02億元，季增78.87%，年增2.85倍，每股純益2.08元。尖點科技2026年上半年營收31.66億元，毛利率39.58%，年增11.84個百分點，2026年上半年尖點科技稅後純益4.7億元，年增2.61倍，每股純益爲3.25元。
尖點指出，在2026年第二季季營運中，受惠於AI伺服器與高效能運算需求持續強勁，加上產品結構優化，高階鍍膜鑽針產品比重於上半年提升至56%，提前超越原設定全年平均55%的目標。同時，產品價格在上半年已有調漲之下，有助改善產品原物料成本如鎢原料價格上漲帶來的不利，同時，目前2026年下半年鑽針產品並沒有再調漲的計畫。
paras_en: AI demand is booming, and Jiantian Technology (8021‑TW), a PCB drill bit and contract drilling service provider, is actively expanding its drill bit production capacity to meet market needs. The company has submitted a proposal to the Financial Supervisory Commission to raise more than 1.68 billion NTD through the issuance of cash‑add shares and convertible corporate bonds.

Jiantian plans to issue 480 million NTD face‑value unsecured convertible bonds and 4,000 cash‑add shares at a price of 300 NTD each, raising 1.2 billion NTD. Combined with the bond issuance, the total market fundraising will exceed 1.68 billion NTD. The lead underwriter for both issuances is Fubon Securities (6026‑TW).

The company’s PCB drill bit capacity is expanding, with a target of 45 million units per month by year‑end 2024, 70 million by 2027, and 90 million by 2028. The number of contract drilling machines will also increase annually. Jiantian’s capital expenditure for the first half of 2026 is 1.38 billion NTD; the CEO, Lin Ruoping, expects total 2026 capex to reach 3 billion NTD.

The drill bit capacity expansion plan will reach 45 million units per month by year‑end 2024. If the 70 million‑unit target is achieved by year‑end 2027, that represents a 55.56% increase over the 2024 target, and the 2028 target of 90 million units will be double the 2024 level.

In Q2 2026, Jiantian reported revenue of 1.826 billion NTD, a gross margin of 41.78% (up 5.19 pp from the prior quarter and 12.34 pp from the prior year), and net profit after tax of 302 million NTD (up 78.87% from the prior quarter and 2.85× from the prior year), translating to earnings per share of 2.08 NTD. For the first half of 2026, revenue was 3.166 billion NTD, gross margin 39.58% (up 11.84 pp from the prior year), and net profit after tax 470 million NTD (up 2.61× from the prior year), or 3.25 NTD per share.

The company noted that in Q2 2026, strong AI server and high‑performance computing demand, coupled with product mix optimization, raised the proportion of high‑grade coated drill bits to 56% of sales in the first half—surpassing the annual target of 55%. Product price increases in the first half helped offset adverse cost pressures such as rising tungsten raw material prices. No price hikes are planned for drill bit products in the second half of 2026.

items.title: 金價衝破4600、美債破40兆美元 資金開始瘋狂流向Halo資產
items.title_en: Gold Surpasses $4,600, U.S. Treasuries Hit $40 Trillion as Funds Rush to Halo Assets
paras: 國際金價上周五(21日)站上每盎司4600美元，30年期美債殖利率同週觸及5.337%，回到2007年金融海嘯前高點，而與此同時，美國財政部宣布聯邦債務餘額首破40兆美元。
當「最鋒利的矛(AI)」利潤待兌、「最堅固的盾(美債)」顯露裂縫，資金轉向低淘汰率、難複製的Halo資產如油氣、電力、礦產、港鐵與核心地段不動產皆屬此類。
《博聞財經》報導，從去年底迄今，深圳灣豪宅累計吸金約550億元，新房均價每平方公尺15—20萬元，最高單價39.86萬元，買家約七成是90後，晶片、AI創辦人及技術合夥人成主力，95後創一代也現身市場。
香港新世界旗下豪宅產品線PAVILIA COLLECTION首次進軍中國大陸，落子南山大沙河、深圳灣上游，定名「THE BAY PAVILIA灣上雲啟｜灣滶」，預計第三季推出銷售檔期，2000平方呎起跳，兩梯兩戶。
分析人士認為，全球避險情緒不會因為企業單季財報消散，核心城市不可再生的濱水豪宅，正從「消費品」重估為「主權信用風險對沖」的實體截面。
報導指出，當美債破40兆、美元信用鬆動、AI與美債同時顯出脆弱時，資金不再只買「故事」，而想握住一種物理上切下來就屬於你、且供給被海岸線鎖死的那一塊真實世界，深圳灣豪宅就是這種「被切出來的樣本」並其兼具著以下三層功能：一是Halo資產(重資產、低淘汰、難複製)；二是對美債信用風險的實物對沖；三是宏觀經濟動盪裡可觀測、可抵押、可傳代的「實體切片」，而不是財報上的數字。
paras_en: International gold prices topped $4,600 per ounce on Friday (21st) last week, while the 30‑year U.S. Treasury yield reached 5.337%, returning to its pre‑2007 financial crisis high, and at the same time the U.S. Treasury announced that the federal debt balance had broken the $40 trillion threshold.

When the "sharpest spear (AI)" profits are pending and the "sturdest shield (Treasuries)" shows cracks, capital shifts to low‑turnover, hard‑to‑replicate Halo assets such as oil and gas, electricity, mining, railways, and core‑location real estate.

According to a report by Bo Wen Finance, Shenzhen Bay luxury homes have attracted about CNY 55 billion in capital since the end of last year, with new‑home average prices ranging from CNY 150,000 to 200,000 per square meter, a peak unit price of CNY 398,600, and roughly 70% of buyers are post‑90s, chip and AI founders and technical partners, with some post‑95s also entering the market.

Hong Kong New World’s luxury product line PAVILIA COLLECTION has entered mainland China for the first time, launching in Nanshan Dashihe and upstream Shenzhen Bay, named "THE BAY PAVILIA Bay Shang Yun Qi | Bay Dao", with sales expected to start in Q3, starting at 2,000 square feet, two lifts, two units.

Analysts believe that global safe‑haven sentiment will not dissipate due to a single quarter’s corporate earnings, and that core cities’ non‑renewable waterfront luxury homes are being re‑rated from "consumer goods" to "physical hedges against sovereign credit risk."

The report notes that when U.S. Treasuries break $40 trillion, dollar credit loosens, and both AI and Treasuries show fragility, capital no longer buys only "stories" but seeks a tangible slice of the real world that is physically yours and whose supply is locked by the coastline; Shenzhen Bay luxury homes are such a "cut‑out sample," offering three layers of function: first, Halo assets (heavy, low‑turnover, hard‑to‑replicate); second, a physical hedge against Treasury credit risk; third, a tangible, observable, collateralizable, generational slice of the macro‑economic turbulence, not just numbers on a financial statement.

items.title: 中國旺旺被曝要裁員1,000人 要求員工反思
items.title_en: China Want Want Exposed for Planning 1,000 Layoffs, Demanding Staff Self‑Reflection
paras: 本月上旬，中國旺旺集團董事長蔡衍明發布的內部信不脛而走，蔡衍明在信中稱公司遇到了「重大經營危機」，且要淘汰沒有貢獻的幹部。消息一出，引發公眾與行業對旺旺集團的廣泛討論。
多名接近旺旺集團的人士透露，集團在近期採取了裁員計畫。一名離職員工表示，他聽說集團計劃的裁員目標是1,000人左右，目前已經裁員約400人。
據《財新》21日（上周五）報導，另一名離職員工說，其所在部門計劃砍掉8%員工，這意味著約有近20人被裁。
此外，多名員工稱，旺旺集團近期要求員工撰寫自評報告，「這是第一次公司因為淨利潤大幅下滑，讓所有員工來反思，」一名接近旺旺的人士說。
具體而言，旺旺集團要求總部全體人員必須針對過去一年實際結果，展開「確實認識自己•切實反思自己」的回顧，但單位最高主管無需參與。
集團要求，員工自評報告應該秉持「確實認識自己、切實反思自己、隨時提醒自己、篤實把握自己、絕對發揮自己」的原則，「真實、客觀地剖析自己的不足」，且要「以事實為依據、數據為支撐」。
員工自評後，由直屬主管（N+1）、隔級主管（N+2）按回顧表所列維度逐項評分，評分鏈條最高至單位最高主管。
日前中國旺旺一封內部公開信在網上流傳，蔡衍明將集團2026年度第一季業績失速直接定性為「重大經營危機」，直言「我們靠著幾個拳頭產品過了近30年的好日子，一直未能創新求變」、「今天的苦果，是過去幾年來因循怠惰所致」。
業績預告顯示，中國旺旺2026年度第一季（2026年4月1日至6月30日）收入較上年同期下降約6%，淨利潤銳減約38%。業績承壓之下，蔡衍明坦言沒有產出、沒有功勞的（旺旺人），都會被淘汰。
paras_en: In early this month, an internal letter from Cai Yanming, chairman of China Want Want Group, spread rapidly; in the letter Cai said the company faced a “major operational crisis” and would eliminate unproductive executives. The news sparked widespread discussion among the public and industry about Want Want Group.
Several sources close to the group disclosed that it has recently launched a layoff plan. A former employee said he heard the target is roughly 1,000 staff, and about 400 have already been let go.
According to Caixin on the 21st (last Friday), another former employee said his department plans to cut 8% of its workforce, meaning roughly 20 people would be dismissed.

In addition, multiple employees said Want Want has recently required staff to write self‑assessment reports, “the first time the company has asked all employees to reflect because net profit has dropped sharply,” said a source close to Want Want.

Specifically, the group requires every employee at headquarters to review the past year’s actual results and conduct a “truly know yourself · genuinely reflect on yourself” exercise, though the highest‑level unit supervisors are exempt.

The self‑assessment must follow the principles of “truly know yourself, genuinely reflect, constantly remind yourself, firmly grasp yourself, and fully unleash yourself,” and must “honestly and objectively analyze one’s shortcomings,” based on “facts and supported by data.”

After the self‑assessment, the employee’s direct supervisor (N+1) and the next‑level supervisor (N+2) score each dimension listed in the review form, with the scoring chain extending up to the unit’s top supervisor.

A recent internal open letter from China Want Want circulated online, in which Cai Yanming labeled the group’s sluggish Q1 2026 performance as a “major operational crisis,” bluntly stating, “We have lived on a few flagship products for nearly 30 years without innovation, and today’s bitter fruit is the result of years of complacency.”

The performance preview shows that for Q1 2026 (April 1 – June 30, 2026), Want Want’s revenue fell about 6% year‑on‑year and net profit plunged roughly 38%. Under this pressure, Cai admitted that any “Want Want people” without output or merit would be eliminated.

items.title: 永虹先進三階段發展無人系統任務生態系 歐系軍工業到訪
items.title_en: Yonghong Advanced Expands UAV System Mission Ecosystem in Three Phases, Attracts European Defense Industry Visit
paras: 永虹先進(6618-TW)正擴大在無人機產業的布局，一口氣發表巡檢偵查無人機、六軸大型物流無人機和無人機VR模擬器三大產品與應用方案，吸引歐系軍工業者到訪交流。
永虹先進長期深耕航太級高階熱塑性碳纖維複合材料，南投新廠已取得AS9100D航太品質系統認證，近年也持續串聯國內無人機產業夥伴，其中，與台灣無人機燃油噴嘴大廠豐兆航太簽署共同開發採購合約意向書，雙方將就Cougar無人機展開共同開發、製造及市場拓展。
永虹先進表示，聚焦小型無人機「巡檢＋偵查」應用，依照規劃航線模擬於廠房及周邊環境執行巡檢任務，展示定點觀察、區域偵查、環境巡視及影像資訊蒐集等功能，驗證無人機於複雜場域快速取得第一線資訊的能力，可望進一步延伸至智慧巡檢、災害應變及安全監控等應用場域。
其次則鎖定六軸大型無人機物流運輸應用，現場完整呈現貨物裝載、指定地點起飛、空中運輸、航線飛行、指定區域降落至物資交付等任務流程，將大型無人機由單純展示載重能力，進一步導入實際物流任務情境，未來可望應用於偏遠地區運補、緊急物資配送及災害救援等特殊運輸需求。
永虹先進也強調全台首創的「VR無人機維修模擬暨多旋翼、定翼機考照與評分系統」，除提供飛行模擬，更將無人機維修學習、零組件辨識、操作程序、考照模擬及學習評量導入沉浸式虛擬環境，可望應用於學校與教育單位、考照機構、企業與產業培訓，以及政府、國防與救災單位等場域，透過虛擬環境反覆訓練，降低實機操作風險及訓練成本，並建立標準化的無人機教育與評量模式。
永虹先進期透過不同的產品定位，串聯成逐步成形的無人系統任務生態系，前端由小型無人機負責偵查、巡檢及資訊蒐集，中段透過大型物流無人機執行物資運送及補給，後端則由VR系統負責操作人員訓練、維修教育、能力評量和人才培育，推動公司由航太先進材料供應商朝無人機整合型解決方案業者發展。
paras_en: Yonghong Advanced (6618‑TW) is expanding its footprint in the UAV industry by announcing three new products and application solutions in a single press release: a patrol‑inspection UAV, a six‑axis large‑scale logistics UAV, and a UAV VR simulator, drawing European defense industry visitors for discussion.

Yonghong Advanced has long focused on aerospace‑grade high‑performance thermoplastic carbon‑fiber composites. Its new Nantou plant has obtained AS9100D aerospace quality system certification, and in recent years it has continued to link domestic UAV partners. Notably, it signed a joint development and procurement memorandum of intent with Taiwan’s major UAV fuel nozzle manufacturer, Fengzhao Aerospace, to jointly develop, manufacture, and market the Cougar UAV.

Yonghong Advanced says it is focusing on small UAV “patrol‑inspection” applications. According to its plan, the UAV will simulate flight routes in the factory and surrounding environment to perform inspection tasks, demonstrating point observation, area reconnaissance, environmental surveillance, and image data collection. This validates the UAV’s ability to quickly acquire frontline information in complex settings and could be extended to smart inspection, disaster response, and security monitoring.

Next, the company targets a six‑axis large UAV for logistics transport. The demonstration showcased the full mission flow: loading cargo, taking off from a designated location, air transport, flight path, and landing in a specified area for delivery. This moves the large UAV from merely demonstrating payload capacity to real logistics scenarios, with future applications in remote area supply, emergency delivery, and disaster relief special transport needs.

Yonghong Advanced also highlighted Taiwan’s first VR UAV maintenance simulation and multi‑rotor/ fixed‑wing certification and scoring system. Beyond flight simulation, it incorporates UAV maintenance learning, component identification, operating procedures, certification simulation, and learning assessment into an immersive virtual environment. This can be used by schools, training institutions, certification bodies, enterprises, industry training, and government, defense, and disaster relief units, reducing real‑aircraft operation risk and training costs while establishing a standardized UAV education and assessment model.

Through different product positioning, Yonghong Advanced aims to link together a gradually forming UAV system mission ecosystem: front‑end small UAVs handle reconnaissance, patrol, and information gathering; mid‑segment large logistics UAVs perform material transport and resupply; back‑end VR systems train operators, educate maintenance, assess capabilities, and cultivate talent, driving the company’s evolution from an aerospace advanced material supplier to an integrated UAV solution provider.

items.title_en: Jiantian Technology Urgently Raises Capital, Plans to Issue Unsecured Convertible Bonds and Cash-Add Shares Over 1.68 Billion NTD
paras: AI需求旺盛，PCB 鑽針及代鑽服務廠尖點科技 (8021-TW)在鑽針開新產能的規劃上，也積極衝刺因應市場需求，同時，尖點科技並送件金管會將以發行現增股及發行可轉換公司債(CB)進行市場籌資合計逾16.8億元。
尖點科技送件擬辦理發行4.8億元面額無擔保可轉換公司債並加上發行現金增資股4000張，以暫訂以300元發行，籌資12億元，兩者合計進行市場籌資合計逾16.8億元。兩者的主辦券商爲福邦證券(6026-TW)。
尖點科技在PCB鑽針產能正在擴充預計今年底達每月4500萬支，2027年規劃達成7000萬支，到2028年達到月產能9000萬支的目標，同時代鑽孔的設備數量也將再逐年提升。同時，尖點科技2026年上半年的資本支出金額爲13.8億元，林若萍指出，規劃2026年全年的資本支出將達30億元。
尖點科技的鑽針產能擴充案，預計到今年底達每月4500萬支，如依規劃在2027年底達成每月7000萬支鑽針的產能，等於較今年底的產能再增加55.56%，到2028年的底鑽針每月產能將較今年成長1倍。
尖點科技2026年第二季財報營收18.26億元，毛利率41.78%，季增5.19個百分點，年增12.34個百分點，單季稅後純益3.02億元，季增78.87%，年增2.85倍，每股純益2.08元。尖點科技2026年上半年營收31.66億元，毛利率39.58%，年增11.84個百分點，2026年上半年尖點科技稅後純益4.7億元，年增2.61倍，每股純益爲3.25元。
尖點指出，在2026年第二季季營運中，受惠於AI伺服器與高效能運算需求持續強勁，加上產品結構優化，高階鍍膜鑽針產品比重於上半年提升至56%，提前超越原設定全年平均55%的目標。同時，產品價格在上半年已有調漲之下，有助改善產品原物料成本如鎢原料價格上漲帶來的不利，同時，目前2026年下半年鑽針產品並沒有再調漲的計畫。
paras_en: AI demand is booming, and Jiantian Technology (8021‑TW), a PCB drill bit and contract drilling service provider, is actively expanding its drill bit production capacity to meet market needs. The company has submitted a proposal to the Financial Supervisory Commission to raise more than 1.68 billion NTD through the issuance of cash‑add shares and convertible corporate bonds.

Jiantian plans to issue 480 million NTD face‑value unsecured convertible bonds and 4,000 cash‑add shares at a price of 300 NTD each, raising 1.2 billion NTD. Combined with the bond issuance, the total market fundraising will exceed 1.68 billion NTD. The lead underwriter for both issuances is Fubon Securities (6026‑TW).

The company’s PCB drill bit capacity is expanding, with a target of 45 million units per month by year‑end 2024, 70 million by 2027, and 90 million by 2028. The number of contract drilling machines will also increase annually. Jiantian’s capital expenditure for the first half of 2026 is 1.38 billion NTD; the CEO, Lin Ruoping, expects total 2026 capex to reach 3 billion NTD.

The drill bit capacity expansion plan will reach 45 million units per month by year‑end 2024. If the 70 million‑unit target is achieved by year‑end 2027, that represents a 55.56% increase over the 2024 target, and the 2028 target of 90 million units will be double the 2024 level.

In Q2 2026, Jiantian reported revenue of 1.826 billion NTD, a gross margin of 41.78% (up 5.19 pp from the prior quarter and 12.34 pp from the prior year), and net profit after tax of 302 million NTD (up 78.87% from the prior quarter and 2.85× from the prior year), translating to earnings per share of 2.08 NTD. For the first half of 2026, revenue was 3.166 billion NTD, gross margin 39.58% (up 11.84 pp from the prior year), and net profit after tax 470 million NTD (up 2.61× from the prior year), or 3.25 NTD per share.

The company noted that in Q2 2026, strong AI server and high‑performance computing demand, coupled with product mix optimization, raised the proportion of high‑grade coated drill bits to 56% of sales in the first half—surpassing the annual target of 55%. Product price increases in the first half helped offset adverse cost pressures such as rising tungsten raw material prices. No price hikes are planned for drill bit products in the second half of 2026.

items.title: 【崩盤倒數】美債飆19年新高！ 99%散戶恐做錯這一步！
items.title_en: Countdown to Collapse: U.S. Treasuries Hit 19-Year High! 99% of Retail Investors Fear They're Making the Wrong Move!
paras: 「美債殖利率飆高」、「30年期美債創近20年新高」，很多人問江江：「是不是金融風暴要來了？AI泡沫是不是破了？要不要先全部賣掉？」先講結論：股市絕對不會大崩盤！千萬別殺低手中好股票！
為什麼！這一次，美債殖利率確實拉出警報，但市場最新發展告訴我們一件很重要的事：當長天期利率飆得太高，連美國政府自己都開始坐不住了。一旦利率如果失控飆升，受傷的不只是股市，而是房貸、企業融資、美國政府利息支出，甚至整個金融體系。
所以，美國政府不可能眼睜睜看著長端利率一路失速。這就像一輛高速行駛的卡車，方向盤當然不能永遠往右打。當市場出現過度恐慌，政策與資金往往就會開始修正。
你可以把美國政府想像成一個持有「無限額度信用卡」的頂級富豪，雖然每個月要繳的利息高得嚇人，但他最重要、也萬萬不能丟掉的，就是他的「信用」與「多頭牛市」地位。為了維持老大的尊嚴，美國財政部跟聯準會絕對會使出各種壓箱寶來護航。
這次，美國政府在利率政策上，已經鋪設了兩條長短端利率下行的「祕密管道」：
1. 短端利率的「穩定幣效應」：你有注意到近期比特幣單週暴漲24%嗎？這可不是單純的投機，背後大有文章！當比特幣大漲，做為交易媒介的美元穩定幣（如USDT、USDC）規模就會急速膨脹。這些發行商為了保證資產安全，必須大量買進「美國短期國債」。這項龐大的新需求，會直接推升短債價格，進而壓低短天期美債殖利率！
2. 長端利率的「財政部回購計劃」：另一邊，美國財政部也正式打開了長天期美債的「回購計劃」。當財政部自己下場當買家、大舉買回長債時，市場上的長端殖利率壓力自然就降了下來。
請試想一下：當這套組合拳打下來，無風險利率一旦從5%往4%甚至3.5% 下降，神奇的「折現效應」就啟動了！股票本質上是風險資產，像AI、科技股這種「長久期資產」，市場看重的是它們未來極高的高速獲利。折現率一降，它們未來的現金流折算回現在的價值，就會呈現幾何級數飆升，直接拉高本益比估值！
不僅如此，利率下降還能直接寬鬆金融條件，降低企業的融資與營運成本。你想想，建置資料中心、採購GPU、伺服器、電力與散熱等，哪一項不需要大筆資金？融資成本一低，企業蓋AI的資金壓力減輕，獲利自然提升！所以，短線的震盪，根本不是末日，而是給AI及科技股「重新定價」的黃金大行情！
所以，你現在不是跟著市場擔憂，而是要開始問下一個問題：如果利率恐慌逐漸鈍化，下一批最有成長性的股票在哪裡？而我的答案，依然是三個字：「CPO」。
輝達近期宣布以CPO技術打造的Spectrum-X乙太網路交換器正式進入全面量產，敲響了「矽光子時代」的鐘聲。根據法人研究，輝達與大廠的CPO出貨預期將在2028年大放異彩。其領先業界的晶片設計與CUDA軟體生態圈，就是它最堅不可摧的帝國護城河。
GPU是AI的大腦，CPO與矽光子，就是未來AI的神經系統。而這條產業鏈裡，台灣剛好有一批公司卡在非常關鍵的位置。
聯亞的核心利基在於磷化銦（InP）磊晶與高速雷射元件。隨800G、1.6T與矽光子外部光源需求提升，上游關鍵材料價值同步放大。近期市場對InP供應與高速傳輸需求持續關注，聯亞屬於CPO供應鏈中「越往高速規格升級，越有機會受惠」的代表。
華星光(4979-TW)
華星光具備高速光通訊模組與相關元件布局，直接受惠AI資料中心傳輸規格升級。當市場從800G往1.6T推進，高階產品組合提升有助改善營運槓桿。它的護城河在於長期光通訊技術與客戶驗證能力，若高速產品持續放量，獲利彈性值得追蹤。
波若威(3163-TW)
上半年獲利較去年同期大幅成長，基本面已開始反映高速光通訊需求。其強項是光被動元件與光纖陣列製程能力，在CPO架構中屬於高精密度連接的重要角色。若FAU需求持續放量，營收與獲利成長仍有延續空間。
上詮目前仍在投資與轉型階段，上半年虧損，因此不能單純用短線EPS評價。但值得注意的是，7月營收已恢復年成長，高階跳線及CPO相關產品開始出貨，市場預期後續FAU出貨量提升，有機會改善營運結構。它屬於「先卡位、等待量產」型標的。
汎銓並非純光通訊廠，而是切入AI、先進製程與矽光子相關檢測分析。它的價值在於高階晶片與矽光子技術越複雜，驗證與故障分析的重要性越高。若AI晶片與矽光子研發持續增加，檢測服務有機會跟著放大，屬於CPO趨勢中的「賣鏟子」概念，是隱藏版的潛力股。

This time the Treasury yield spike is indeed a warning, but the market’s latest developments tell us something crucial: when long‑term rates climb too high, even the U.S. government can’t sit still. If rates run out of control, it’s not just equities that suffer—mortgages, corporate financing, U.S. government interest costs, and the entire financial system would be hurt.

Therefore the U.S. government cannot just watch long‑end rates spiral downwards. It’s like a high‑speed truck that can’t keep steering right forever. When the market panics excessively, policy and capital usually start to correct.

You can picture the U.S. government as a billionaire with an "unlimited‑credit‑card"—the monthly interest bill is terrifying, but the most important thing he cannot lose is his "credit" and "bull‑market" status. To preserve that prestige, the Treasury and the Fed will pull out every tool in the toolbox to protect the system.
This time the U.S. government has already set up two “secret channels” to push long‑ and short‑term rates lower:

1. The short‑end “stablecoin effect”: Did you notice Bitcoin jumped 24% in a single week recently? It’s not just pure speculation—there’s a bigger story. When Bitcoin rallies, the dollar‑denominated stablecoins used for trading (like USDT, USDC) expand rapidly. Their issuers, to keep assets safe, must buy massive amounts of short‑term U.S. Treasury bills. This new demand lifts short‑term bond prices and drives short‑term yields down!

2. The long‑end “Treasury buy‑back plan”: On the other side, the U.S. Treasury has officially opened a repurchase program for long‑dated Treasuries. When the Treasury itself steps in as a buyer and purchases large volumes of long bonds, pressure on long‑term yields naturally eases.

Imagine this combo punch: once the risk‑free rate falls from 5% to 4% or even 3.5%, the magical “discount effect” kicks in! Stocks are fundamentally risky assets, and for long‑duration assets like AI and tech stocks, the market values their future high‑speed earnings. A lower discount rate inflates the present value of their future cash flows exponentially, pushing price‑to‑earnings multiples skyward!

Moreover, lower rates directly ease financial conditions, reducing corporate financing and operating costs. Think about building data centers, buying GPUs, servers, power and cooling—each requires huge capital. When financing costs drop, AI projects become cheaper, profits rise! So short‑term volatility isn’t an apocalypse; it’s a golden re‑pricing wave for AI and tech stocks!
So instead of worrying with the market, ask the next question: if rate panic gradually fades, where will the next batch of high‑growth stocks be? My answer remains three letters: "CPO".

Nvidia recently announced that its Spectrum‑X Ethernet switch built with CPO technology has entered full‑scale production, heralding the "silicon‑photonics era." Institutional research expects Nvidia’s CPO shipments with major OEMs to shine by 2028. Its industry‑leading chip design and CUDA software ecosystem form an unbreakable moat.
GPUs are the brain of AI; CPO and silicon‑photonics are the future AI nervous system. Within this supply chain, Taiwan happens to host a group of companies in critical positions.
Lian Ya (3081‑TW)

Lian Ya’s core advantage lies in indium phosphide (InP) epitaxy and high‑speed laser components. With demand rising for 800G, 1.6T and silicon‑photonics external light sources, the value of upstream key materials expands in tandem. Recent market focus on InP supply and high‑speed transmission makes Lian Ya a representative that benefits more as specs move to higher speeds within the CPO supply chain.
Hua Xing Guang (4979‑TW)

Hua Xing Guang offers high‑speed optical communication modules and related components, directly benefiting from AI data‑center transmission upgrades. As the market moves from 800G to 1.6T, its premium product mix improves operating leverage. Its moat rests on long‑term optical‑communication technology and validated customer base; if high‑speed products keep scaling, profit flexibility is worth watching.
Bo Ruo Wei (3163‑TW)

In the first half of the year profit surged compared with the same period last year, and fundamentals are already reflecting high‑speed optical‑communication demand. Its strength is in passive optical components and fiber‑array processing, playing a high‑precision connection role in the CPO architecture. If FAU demand continues to grow, revenue and profit growth have further room.
Shang Quan (3363‑TW)

Shang Quan is still in an investment and transformation phase and posted a loss in the first half, so short‑term EPS valuation is inappropriate. However, July revenue returned to year‑over‑year growth, with high‑end jumpers and CPO‑related products shipping. The market expects later FAU shipments to rise, potentially improving its operating structure. It is a "position‑first, wait‑for‑mass‑production" type stock.
Fan Quan (6830‑TW)

Fan Quan is not a pure optical‑communication maker; it focuses on AI, advanced‑process and silicon‑photonics testing and analysis. Its value lies in the growing need for verification and failure analysis as chips and silicon‑photonics become more complex. If AI chip and silicon‑photonics R&D keep expanding, its testing services could scale, fitting the CPO trend’s "selling shovels" concept—a hidden‑potential stock.

items.title: 《大賣空》貝瑞拋售阿里巴巴、稱「股價太貴」！轉手買入「這一股」
items.title_en: Michael Burry Sells Alibaba, Calls Its Stock Too Expensive, Switches to JD
paras: 以押注美國房市崩盤聞名的《大賣空》原型投資人貝瑞（Michael Burry）批評阿里巴巴(09988-HK) 股價估值過高，並透露自己近期已退出這家中國科技巨頭的持股，轉而在其競爭對手京東集團(09618-HK) 建立一筆「大額」持倉。
根據《彭博》報導，貝瑞在Substack發文表示，他原本計畫在一、兩個月後將大部分資金重新投入阿里巴巴，但如今已改變想法。他指出，除非阿里巴巴股價跌至目前的一半，否則他不會重新產生投資興趣。
貝瑞是Scion Capital Management創辦人，因在2008年全球金融危機前押注美國房市下跌而成名。
他此次發表上述看法之際，阿里巴巴才宣布計畫透過發行新股籌集約800億港元（約102億美元），為AI投資提供資金。若完成，這將成為香港市場有史以來規模最大的上市公司增發集資案。
對於阿里巴巴透過發行新股籌資的做法，貝瑞直言自己「我無法認同發行新股這件事」，並預期公司投入資本報酬率仍將持續下滑。
阿里巴巴近期公布截至6月底的季度財報，獲利較去年同期大幅下滑75%。隨著公司加大AI相關資本支出，進一步加劇了投資者對中國科技業未來回報的擔憂。
股價表現同樣承受壓力。阿里巴巴美國存託憑證(BABA-US) 今年以來累計下跌18.6%，僅上週五（21日）單日就下挫8.6%；在香港掛牌的阿里巴巴股價今年迄今也下跌13.9%。
值得注意的是，貝瑞今年4月才透露建立阿里巴巴的新持倉。
阿里巴巴則在週日（23日）另行宣布，此次增發新股的定價為每股112.70港元，相較之下，香港股市上週五收盤價為123港元。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Michael Burry, the original investor behind the book "The Big Short" known for betting on the collapse of the U.S. housing market, criticized Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. (09988-HK) for being overvalued and revealed that he has recently exited his holdings in the Chinese tech giant, instead building a large position in its competitor JD.com (09618-HK).

According to Bloomberg, Burry wrote on Substack that he had originally planned to reinvest most of his capital back into Alibaba in one or two months, but has now changed his mind. He said he would not be interested in re-entering the company unless its stock price fell to about half of its current level.
Burry is the founder of Scion Capital Management and became famous for betting on the decline of the U.S. housing market before the 2008 global financial crisis.

At the time Burry made these remarks, Alibaba had just announced plans to raise about HK$80 billion (US$10.2 billion) by issuing new shares to fund AI investments. If completed, it would be the largest share‑issuance capital‑raising deal ever in the Hong Kong market.
Regarding Alibaba’s new‑share issuance, Burry said, “I cannot endorse the act of issuing new shares,” and expects the company’s capital‑return rate to continue to decline.

Alibaba recently released its Q2 2024 earnings, showing a 75% drop in profit year‑on‑year. The company’s increased AI‑related capital expenditures have further heightened investors’ concerns about the future returns of Chinese technology firms.

The stock has also been under pressure. Alibaba’s U.S. Depositary Receipts (BABA‑US) have fallen 18.6% year‑to‑date, dropping 8.6% on Friday the 21st; the Hong Kong‑listed Alibaba shares have fallen 13.9% so far this year.
It is worth noting that Burry only disclosed his new Alibaba position in April of this year.
Alibaba announced on Sunday the 23rd that the new share issuance would be priced at HK$112.70 per share, compared with the Hong Kong market closing price of HK$123 on Friday.
