items.title: 標普500恐跌15%至20%？策略師警告：美債殖利率逼近5%恐引爆股市「去風險」
items.title_en: S&P 500 Could Fall 15% to 20%? Strategists Warn: Near‑5% Treasury Yields May Trigger Market 'Risk‑Off'
paras: 若美國長天期公債殖利率持續走高，市場情勢可能很快進一步惡化。市場研究機構MRB Partners全球策略合夥人Phillip Colmar警告，若10年期美債殖利率持續走高，標普500指數甚至可能回落15%至20%。
根據《Business Insider》報導，Colmar本週在給客戶的報告中指出，長天期美債殖利率的上升，已讓股市處於爆發一波「去風險」行情的臨界點。
上週10年期美債殖利率一度升破4.7%，30年期殖利率也突破5.2%。債券投資人日益擔心政府債務持續攀升、經濟成長預期強勁，以及美伊戰爭持續帶來的通膨壓力。
Colmar上週五（21日）表示，如果長天期公債殖利率持續走高，10年期殖利率接近5%大關，可能讓投資人受到驚嚇，進而引發標普500指數下跌15%至20%。
談到10年期公債殖利率時，他表示：「只要市場看起來殖利率還會繼續上升，而且沒有任何力量能阻止它，就可能在殖利率突破5%之前，引發一波去風險事件。」
Colmar目前並未預測美債殖利率下一步確切走勢，但他表示，目前投資立場仍偏向支持經濟成長。
不過，他指出，美國財政部本週試圖壓低長天期公債殖利率的措施，反而可能適得其反，導致殖利率進一步走高。
美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）日前表示，財政部將擴大公債回購規模，藉此降低市場上的債券供給，希望進一步壓低殖利率。
但Colmar認為，這項措施可能讓市場產生一種印象，即川普政府試圖壓低公債殖利率，卻沒有處理殖利率上升的根本原因，也就是市場對通膨的疑慮。
Colmar表示，由於這項措施並未與聯準會（Fed）協調，也可能向市場釋放出財政部正在恐慌的訊號。聯準會此前已表示，希望讓所持政府公債到期後自然退出資產負債表。
Colmar表示，市場很容易察覺到政策制定者的「恐慌」。

為何美債殖利率上升會打擊股市？

長天期美債殖利率走高對股市的衝擊，主要來自兩個層面。
首先，殖利率上升通常會對成長型股票造成壓力。原因在於，投資人會將長期公債所提供的無風險報酬率，與股票市場未來具有不確定性的長期報酬進行比較。
由於目前市場很大一部分估值建立在AI將提升生產力的長期預期上，一旦AI交易陷入停滯，可能進一步拖累整體市場。
其次，政府公債殖利率上升也會影響AI企業的借貸成本。這些企業目前正投入大量資本建設AI基礎設施，而更高的融資成本將壓縮投資資本的整體報酬率，並降低企業獲利。
Colmar表示，AI企業目前承受著巨大的投資變現壓力，市場對其未來獲利的預期也已非常高。若借貸成本持續上升，企業實現市場預期的投資回報所需時間將被拉長，將促使投資人下修獲利預期，並要求企業更加嚴格控管資本支出，進而導致股價下跌。
他表示：「最終可能形成一個預期落差：AI本身或許仍是一個不錯的題材，但市場預期實在太高，企業如今已無法達到這些預期。」
對於擔心公債殖利率進一步上升的投資人，Colmar也提出幾項可以強化投資組合的策略。
其中一項做法是降低AI股票的曝險，同時增加防禦型產業的配置，例如醫療保健類股。相較於其他傳統防禦型產業，醫療保健類股通常對利率變化的敏感度較低。
此外，他表示，金融類股在利率走高的環境下通常也有較佳表現。
可用於布局上述投資方向的基金，包括先鋒醫療股指數ETF(VHT-US) 及SPDR 金融類股ETF(XLF-US) 。
paras_en: If U.S. long‑term Treasury yields continue to rise, market conditions could deteriorate rapidly. MRB Partners global strategist Phillip Colmar warned that if the 10‑year Treasury yield keeps climbing, the S&P 500 could fall 15% to 20%.
According to Business Insider, Colmar noted in a client report this week that the rise in long‑term Treasury yields has pushed the market to the brink of a 'risk‑off' wave.

Last week the 10‑year Treasury yield briefly breached 4.7%, and the 30‑year yield surpassed 5.2%. Bond investors are increasingly worried about rising government debt, strong growth expectations, and ongoing inflationary pressure from the U.S.–Iran conflict.
Colmar said on Friday (the 21st) that if long‑term Treasury yields keep climbing and the 10‑year yield nears the 5% threshold, investors could be shocked, triggering a 15% to 20% drop in the S&P 500.
When discussing the 10‑year Treasury yield, he said: 'If the market believes yields will keep rising and nothing can stop them, a risk‑off event could erupt before the 5% barrier is breached.'
Colmar does not yet predict the exact next move of Treasury yields, but he remains supportive of economic growth in his current investment stance.
However, he pointed out that the Treasury's recent attempts to lower long‑term yields may backfire, pushing yields higher.
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent recently said the Treasury would expand bond repurchase programs to reduce supply and lower yields.
But Colmar believes this move may create the impression that the Trump administration is trying to suppress yields without addressing the root cause—market concerns about inflation.

Colmar noted that because this measure was not coordinated with the Fed, it could signal Treasury panic to the market. The Fed has previously said it intends to let held government bonds mature and exit the balance sheet naturally.
Colmar said markets are quick to detect policymakers' 'panic'.
Why rising Treasury yields hurt the stock market? The impact of long‑term yields on equities comes from two main angles.
First, rising yields typically pressure growth stocks. Investors compare the risk‑free return from long‑term bonds to the uncertain long‑term returns of the equity market.
Because a large portion of current valuations is built on the expectation that AI will boost productivity, a slowdown in AI trading could further drag down the overall market.

Second, higher Treasury yields also raise borrowing costs for AI firms. These companies are investing heavily in AI infrastructure, and higher financing costs compress overall investment returns and reduce profitability.

Colmar said AI firms are under significant pressure to monetize investments, and market expectations for their future earnings are already very high. If borrowing costs continue to rise, the time needed to achieve expected returns lengthens, prompting investors to cut earnings forecasts and demand tighter capital discipline, leading to falling stock prices.
He added: 'Ultimately, a gap may form between expectations and reality: AI may still be a good theme, but the market's expectations are too high for firms to meet.'
For investors worried about further yield increases, Colmar suggested several strategies to strengthen portfolios.

One approach is to reduce exposure to AI stocks while increasing allocation to defensive sectors, such as healthcare. Compared to other traditional defensive industries, healthcare stocks are generally less sensitive to interest rate changes.
Additionally, he noted that financial stocks tend to perform better in a rising‑rate environment.
Funds that can be used to position toward these investment themes include the Vanguard Health Care ETF (VHT-US) and the SPDR Financial Select Sector ETF (XLF-US).

items.title: 7月行情再現？高盛：儲存股價獲利「落差大」最具吸引力  金融、黃金銅礦成新寵
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮近期出現新的變化。高盛(GS-US) 警告，AI交易開始出現裂痕，投資人需要留意部分AI相關股票的股價漲幅，已經與企業每股盈餘（EPS）表現出現越來越大的落差。與此同時，市場資金也開始轉向過去較少受到關注的領域，包括歐洲與日本銀行股、黃金礦商及銅礦股，都逐漸成為市場新的焦點。
高盛交易員Natasha Tiwana將上週行情形容為典型的「去槓桿行情」，市場跌勢之快，也讓原本認為7月股市拋售已經告一段落的投資人措手不及。
高盛高貝塔動量組合上週下跌12%，AI對沖組合5個交易日則下跌10%。
高盛指出，這次動量股大跌的原因，與7月行情有不少相似之處。雖然AI相關交易的槓桿程度已經從極端高點下降，但市場仍存在大量資金採取「逢低買進」策略，導致部分股票在下跌後迅速出現大量買盤。
不過，高盛認為，這波投資人調整持股、降低風險，搭配AI產業基本面仍然強勁，反而可能替市場9月重新承擔風險創造更健康的環境。

AI投資邏輯改變 儲存、資料中心成高盛首選

高盛認為，AI交易並沒有結束，但投資人現在關注的重點正在改變。
過去市場主要關注「哪些公司能從AI大規模資本支出中受惠」，如今隨著AI運算成本持續下降，投資人開始進一步尋找「哪些公司能真正從AI普及中賺到錢」。
在短線操作上，高盛建議投資人尋找股價表現與企業獲利之間存在明顯落差的股票。
其中，儲存與資料中心兩大板塊尤其受到高盛關注。高盛指出，這些公司的獲利預期已經改善，但股價似乎還沒有完全反映這些變化，因此存在戰術性投資機會。
接下來，輝達(NVDA-US) 第二季財報將成為市場重要觀察焦點，9月接連登場的產業會議，也可能進一步提供AI產業新的投資訊號。
另一方面，AI應用也開始受到更多關注。上週，莫德納(MRNA-US) 與默克藥廠(MRK-US) 宣布合作開發AI輔助藥物，帶動市場對AI醫療與AI藥物研發領域的興趣。
高盛數據顯示，醫療AI相關受惠企業的獲利預期正在改善，專業投資人的態度也開始轉趨正面，進一步吸引更多投資人關注AI藥物研發。

動量股正在換人！軟體取代半導體

高盛指出，市場熱門股的排名也正在快速洗牌。數據顯示，2026年動量因子單日跌幅超過5%的次數，已經超過過去5年的總和。
更值得注意的是，過去一年表現強勢的股票，與最近3個月強勢股的重疊程度已降至多年低點；反過來，過去一年強勢股與最近3個月弱勢股的重疊程度，卻接近歷史高點。
簡單來說，過去一年最熱門的股票，最近反而開始成為市場上的弱勢股。
從市場結構來看，軟體股已取代半導體，成為3個月動量多頭組合中權重最高的產業；半導體與AI相關股票則已轉向空頭組合，顯示市場正在尋找下一批領漲族群。

歐日銀行股崛起 高盛看好後市

高盛認為，市場重新評估聯準會（Fed）可能維持高利率更長時間後，歐洲與日本銀行股的吸引力正在提高。
除了利率環境之外，高盛也看好歐日銀行的其他收入來源，包括手續費收入成長、營運效率改善，以及股利與股票回購等股東回饋，都可能成為銀行股的支撐。
日本銀行股過去3個月已經同時跑贏東證指數與日本半導體類股，而且股價波動相對較低。高盛認為，黏性通膨與升息預期仍可能支持日本銀行股後市表現。
歐洲方面，整體銀行股目前相較美國銀行股仍有約15%的估值折價。
高盛最看好歐洲的希臘銀行股，認為相關銀行估值正在向歐元區核心國家的同業靠攏，但目前仍有約10%的折價，加上潛在併購題材，仍有進一步上漲空間。
值得注意的是，目前歐洲銀行股的投資人持股比例已降至兩年來低點，進一步強化了其配置價值。

黃金、銅礦股也有補漲機會

除了銀行股，高盛也看好黃金與銅等硬資產相關股票。
高盛先前就看好黃金礦商，理由包括中國需求回升，以及市場對聯準會降息的預期升溫。黃金礦商相關組合本月以來已上漲32%，但距離歷史高點仍有約12%的差距。目前本益比約11倍，仍比過去5年平均水準低約20%。
高盛認為，美國財政部擴大公債回購計畫可能推動美元走弱，進而成為黃金礦商下一階段上漲的推力。同時，地緣政治風險持續，也可能讓更多投資人將黃金視為年底前的避險工具。
銅市場同樣受到高盛關注。受到美國關稅風險，以及美國以外地區供應偏緊的支撐，銅價上週一度創下歷史新高。
不過，主要受到中東局勢升溫，以及市場資金過度集中AI交易的影響，銅礦股自2月以來的表現卻一直落後銅價，與其獲利基本面並不相稱。
高盛指出，從供需來看，銅市場仍受到供應緊張支撐；另一方面，7月聯準會會議紀要顯示，目前升息仍缺乏多數支持。如果市場重新預期聯準會政策轉向鴿派，工業金屬可能因此受惠，銅礦股也有機會追上銅價與企業獲利的表現。

高盛提醒：法國政治風險可能被市場低估

除了產業與資金輪動，高盛也提醒另一項市場風險：法國政治局勢。
今年夏季以來，市場看空法國國債的部位持續增加，法國與德國國債利差（OAT-Bund）已擴大至約85個基點，創下階段性新高。
不過，法國股市先前對政治風險的反應並不明顯，直到最近幾天才開始出現波動。
高盛認為，目前法國股市估值已經位於近5年90%分位的高檔，但市場尚未充分反映政治不確定性可能帶來的風險。
接下來幾項政治相關活動值得關注，包括8月27日法國企業主聯合會（Medef）夏季年會，以及8月30日司法部長Darmanin的夏季聚會。
從歷史經驗來看，法國國內股票對政治風險的反應比法國CAC 40指數更加敏感。一旦政治不確定性升高，相關股票與信用利差的連動也會更加明顯，意味著目前高檔估值可能面臨進一步修正壓力。

items.title: 川普向習近平釋善意？美政府傳考慮放行蘋果採購中國長鑫科技記憶體
items.title_en: Trump Extends Olive Branch to Xi? US Government Mulls Allowing Apple to Buy Memory Chips from China’s ChangXin Technology
paras: 最新市場消息指出，川普政府可能考慮允許蘋果(AAPL-US) 向中國長鑫科技(688825-CN) 及長江存儲採購記憶體與儲存晶片，相關決定甚至可能在美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平9月會面後正式對外傳達。
根據《Wccftech》報導，在習近平正式訪美前夕，蘋果分別向中國長鑫科技及長江存儲採購DRAM與NAND模組的計畫，已成為美中地緣政治角力的敏感焦點。
近期已有消息指出，蘋果正測試長鑫科技的DRAM產品，以及長江存儲的NAND模組，顯示兩家中國記憶體業者進入蘋果供應鏈的可能性正在升高。
不過，若合作最終成行，相關中國供應商提供的記憶體產品將僅用於蘋果在中國市場銷售的產品。
根據《金融時報》近日報導，蘋果甚至已積極向川普政府遊說，希望取得向長鑫科技採購DRAM的許可。長鑫科技目前仍因被認為與中國人民解放軍存在關聯，而列在美國五角大廈的黑名單上。
《彭博》記者古爾曼（Mark Gurman）先前也透露，蘋果正與川普政府協商，希望降低未來若採用長鑫科技及長江存儲記憶體後，可能在美國政府引發的政治反彈。
蘋果近來也已公開釋出對中國記憶體供應商的興趣。在最新財報電話會議上，公司表示仍在評估不同的供應來源，並認為採用更多供應商可能有助於改善供應狀況，至於成本方面是否能帶來幫助，目前仍無法確定。
如今，微博爆料帳號「Mobile Chip Expert」更進一步指出，川普政府可能準備批准蘋果分別從長鑫科技及長江存儲採購記憶體與儲存晶片，正式通知可能會在川普與習近平9月一對一會談後發布。
不過，目前這項說法仍屬市場消息，最終是否真的獲得美方批准，仍有待觀察。
這項潛在政策調整也已引發美國國會部分議員反彈。近期已有一批美國國會議員要求蘋果放棄採用中國來源的記憶體，並要求公司在8月21日前承諾不推動相關計畫，並同時揭露其曾與長鑫科技、長江存儲分享的任何技術資訊。
即使川普政府最終放行，長鑫科技是否具備立即滿足蘋果DRAM需求的能力，仍存在疑問。先前已有消息指出，長鑫科技目前產能受到限制。
另一方面，近期消息指出，即使雙方建立商業合作關係，長鑫科技也拒絕向蘋果提供任何價格讓步。
paras_en: The latest market reports indicate that the Trump administration may be considering permitting Apple (AAPL-US) to purchase memory and storage chips from China’s ChangXin Technology (688825-CN) and Yangtze Memory (YMTC), with a decision possibly being publicly announced after President Trump’s September meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

According to Wccftech, Apple’s plans to buy DRAM from ChangXin and NAND modules from Yangtze Memory just before Xi’s official visit to the United States have become a sensitive flashpoint in the US‑China geopolitical rivalry.
Recent reports say Apple is testing ChangXin’s DRAM products and Yangtze Memory’s NAND modules, suggesting that the two Chinese memory makers are increasingly likely to enter Apple’s supply chain.
However, if the cooperation materialises, the memory products supplied by the Chinese vendors would be used only in Apple devices sold in the Chinese market.

The Financial Times recently reported that Apple has even been actively lobbying the Trump administration for permission to buy DRAM from ChangXin, which remains on the U.S. Pentagon’s blacklist due to alleged ties to the People’s Liberation Army.

Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman previously disclosed that Apple is negotiating with the Trump administration to mitigate any political backlash in the United States that could arise if it adopts memory from ChangXin and Yangtze Memory.

Apple has also publicly expressed interest in Chinese memory suppliers. In its latest earnings call, the company said it is still evaluating different sources and believes that adding more suppliers could improve supply conditions, though it cannot yet say whether costs would benefit.

Now a Weibo account called “Mobile Chip Expert” has gone further, claiming the Trump administration may be preparing to approve Apple’s purchases of memory and storage chips from both ChangXin and Yangtze Memory, with formal notification possibly coming after Trump’s one‑on‑one talks with Xi in September.
Nevertheless, this remains a market rumor, and whether the United States will ultimately grant approval is still uncertain.

The potential policy shift has already sparked pushback from some U.S. lawmakers. A group of members of Congress recently urged Apple to abandon any Chinese‑sourced memory, demanding the company commit by August 21 not to pursue the plan and to disclose any technical information it may have shared with ChangXin or Yangtze Memory.

Even if the Trump administration ultimately green‑lights the deal, doubts remain about whether ChangXin can immediately meet Apple’s DRAM needs, as earlier reports suggest the company’s production capacity is currently constrained.
On the other hand, recent news indicates that even if a commercial relationship is established, ChangXin has refused to offer Apple any price concessions.

items.title: AI概念股還能漲？Evercore點名「6大」硬體股：2026年下半年將進一步走高
items.title_en: Can AI Concept Stocks Still Rise? Evercore Names Six Hardware Stocks Set to Climb Further in Late 2026
paras: 人工智慧（AI）硬體支出持續強勁，帶動部分科技股今年大幅上漲。Evercore ISI分析師Amit Daryanani認為，部分今年表現最亮眼的科技股，進入2026年下半年後仍有進一步走高的空間。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，Daryanani近日公布下半年「最值得持有的6檔股票」名單，其中包括儲存設備與資料中心網路供應商。他指出，AI硬體支出強勁，已讓相關企業成為今年科技股市場的重要受惠者。
在儲存設備領域，基於硬碟（HDD）需求持續強勁，Daryanani及其團隊看好希捷科技(STX-US) 與威騰電子(WDC-US) 的後市表現。
Daryanani指出，在儲存產品供應持續吃緊的情況下，希捷科技的定價能力有望進一步提升。
此外，隨著希捷科技的Mozaic 3+硬碟平台已通過主要超大規模資料中心業者的認證並進入量產，該公司也擁有「正在擴大規模的兩年技術領先優勢」。
他補充，希捷科技的Mozaic 4+平台目前也正與全球兩大雲端服務供應商推進量產；至於後續的Mozaic 5+平台，預計明年稍晚開始出貨，並接受客戶認證。
至於威騰電子，Daryanani認為，推論型AI與代理式AI（agentic AI）帶動資料產生速度加快，將進一步推升公司的股價。此外，他也看好威騰電子在投入研發後，將自由現金流全數回饋股東的計畫。
截至目前，威騰電子今年股價已上漲約170%，希捷漲幅則達207%。
在資料中心網路供應商方面，Daryanani點名安費諾(APH-US) 、Arista網路(ANET-US) 與思科系統(CSCO-US) 。
他認為，AI需求持續成長，加上安費諾具備擴大併購規模及拓展終端市場的能力，使其今年及未來都有機會跑贏大盤。
Daryanani指出，安費諾在AI相關銅與光纖連接器領域均具領先地位，因此當客戶在銅與光纖元件之間做選擇時，公司有望成為首選的連接方案供應商。
除了AI之外，安費諾也布局國防與工業市場，旗下產品涵蓋互連系統與天線解決方案，因此Daryanani認為，公司仍存在AI以外的成長機會。
至於Arista網路，Daryanani認為，雲端客戶基礎持續多元化將有助公司成長，未來3至4年更可能出現「超額成長」。企業園區網路架構逐步導入，也將成為另一項成長動能。
他指出，網路市場的總潛在市場規模將持續顯著擴大，而Arista正進一步切入「垂直擴展網路」（scale-up networking）市場，隨著這類網路架構的重要性日益提升，公司有望從中受益。
思科則有望在2027會計年度迎來新的成長機會。Daryanani指出，網路設備更新週期可能為公司帶來「第二階段成長」，進一步補強思科目前已獲既有訂單支持、規模達75億美元的AI營收指引。
此外，Daryanani表示，受惠於其從晶片一路延伸至系統設計的完整架構，思科的Silicon One可程式化網路架構也有望在與博通(AVGO-US) 解決方案的競爭中取得可觀市場機會
Daryanani及其團隊同樣看好蘋果(AAPL-US) 的產品與功能發展路線。
他表示，iPhone產品週期仍具吸引力，累積需求、iPhone 18 Pro產品週期，以及預期中的摺疊iPhone推出，都有望支撐iPhone需求與平均售價，尤其是在基礎款iPhone 18延後推出的情況下。
儘管部分投資人對Apple Intelligence及AI版Siri仍抱持懷疑，但Daryanani認為，如果蘋果能成功推出這些功能，可能延長iPhone產品週期、推動換機需求，並開啟新的營收變現機會。
他更將iPhone形容為消費者AI的「收費站」，認為iPhone是使用者與AI互動的主要裝置。隨著AI工具需求持續增加，蘋果未來可能找到更多方式從這項趨勢中獲取營收。
此外，Daryanani指出，蘋果服務業務過去12季持續維持雙位數成長，即使App Store目前面臨壓力，服務業務的成長仍有望成為公司毛利率的正面因素。
在資本回饋方面，他也認為蘋果將約90%的自由現金流透過股利與股票回購回饋股東，並持續將股東利益置於優先地位，同樣是公司的正面因素。
paras_en: AI hardware spending remains robust, driving a sharp rise in some tech stocks this year. Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani believes that several of the brightest‑performing tech stocks this year still have upside after the second half of 2026.

According to MarketWatch, Daryanani recently released a list of the “six most worth‑holding stocks” for the second half of the year, which includes storage‑equipment and data‑center networking suppliers. He notes that strong AI hardware spending has made these companies key beneficiaries in this year’s tech‑stock market.
In the storage‑equipment space, driven by continued strong demand for hard‑disk drives (HDDs), Daryanani and his team are bullish on Seagate Technology (STX-US) and Western Digital (WDC-US).
Daryanani points out that, with storage product supply staying tight, Seagate’s pricing power is likely to improve further.

Moreover, Seagate’s Mozaic 3+ HDD platform has passed certification by major hyperscale data‑center operators and entered volume production, giving the company a two‑year technology‑lead advantage that is currently being scaled up.

He adds that Seagate’s Mozaic 4+ platform is now being pushed toward volume production with the world’s two largest cloud service providers, and the subsequent Mozaic 5+ platform is expected to ship later next year after customer qualification.

Regarding Western Digital, Daryanani argues that generative AI and agentic AI are accelerating data generation, which should lift the stock further. He also likes the company’s plan to return all free cash flow to shareholders after its R&D investments.
To date, Western Digital’s share price has risen about 170% this year, while Seagate is up roughly 207%.
In the data‑center networking arena, Daryanani calls out Amphenol (APH-US), Arista Networks (ANET-US) and Cisco Systems (CSCO-US).

He believes that continued AI demand, combined with Amphenol’s ability to expand acquisitions and grow its end‑market footprint, gives it the chance to outperform the broader market both this year and going forward.
Daryanani notes that Amphenol leads in AI‑related copper and fiber‑optic connectors, so when customers choose between copper and fiber components, the company is likely to be the preferred supplier.
Beyond AI, Amphenol is also positioning itself in defense and industrial markets, offering interconnect systems and antenna solutions, which Daryanani sees as additional growth avenues outside of AI.

As for Arista Networks, Daryanani sees diversified cloud‑customer bases driving growth, with the potential for “excess returns” over the next three to four years. The rollout of networking in corporate campuses will also add a growth catalyst.

He adds that the total addressable market for networking will keep expanding significantly, and Arista is moving deeper into the “scale‑up networking” segment, positioning it to benefit as these architectures become more critical.

Cisco is expected to encounter a new growth window in fiscal 2027. Daryanani says the network‑equipment refresh cycle could provide a “second‑stage growth” that bolsters Cisco’s AI revenue guidance of $7.5 billion, already supported by existing orders.

Furthermore, Daryanani says Cisco’s Silicon One programmable networking architecture, which spans from chips to system design, could capture sizable market share in competition with Broadcom (AVGO-US) solutions.
Daryanani and his team are also bullish on Apple (AAPL-US) and its product‑development roadmap.

He notes that the iPhone product cycle remains attractive, with cumulative demand, the iPhone 18 Pro cycle, and the anticipated launch of a foldable iPhone expected to support iPhone demand and average selling price, especially as the baseline iPhone 18 rollout is delayed.

Although some investors remain skeptical about Apple Intelligence and an AI‑enabled Siri, Daryanani believes that successful rollout of these features could extend the iPhone cycle, spur upgrade demand, and open new revenue‑monetization opportunities.
He even describes the iPhone as a “toll booth” for consumer AI, viewing it as the primary device for user‑AI interaction. As AI‑tool demand grows, Apple may find more ways to monetize the trend.

Additionally, Daryanani points out that Apple’s services business has posted double‑digit growth for the past twelve quarters; even though the App Store faces pressure, services growth should remain a positive contributor to gross margins.

In terms of capital return, he says Apple plans to return roughly 90% of free cash flow to shareholders via dividends and share buybacks, keeping shareholder interests a top priority, which is another positive factor for the company.

items.title: 美國期中選舉對股市是利多？歷史揭示：今年比以往強、標普500選後12個月從未下跌
items.title_en: Is the U.S. Midterm Election Bullish for Stocks? History Shows This Year Is Stronger Than Usual, and the S&P 500 Has Never Declined in the 12 Months After a Midterm
paras: 儘管美股近期出現回落，市場波動也明顯升高，但若放在歷史脈絡下觀察，今年股市表現仍遠優於典型的美國期中選舉年。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，即使經歷8月20日的市場重挫後，標普500指數今年以來以單純股價計算仍上漲11.6%；相比之下，1954年至2022年間平均期中選舉年在相同時間點則下跌1.3%。
分析指出，在典型的期中選舉年，股市通常要到選舉日前夕才會觸底；之後，市場便會在接下來大部分的12個月內持續穩步上升。
換句話說，即使目前股市再下跌11%，其表現仍不會比典型期中選舉年同期更差。
研究人士指出，股市通常在期中選舉前表現疲弱，原因在於市場會對選舉後可能出現的政府政策感到不確定。在這種不確定性下，股市往往下跌；而一旦不確定性消除，市場便會反彈。
值得注意的是，歷史資料顯示，期中選舉究竟由哪個政黨取得優勢，似乎並不是決定股市選後走勢的關鍵。只要選前的不確定性解除，股市往往都會出現上漲。
然而，今年並未出現這種選前疲弱的走勢。事實上，今年股市表現遠強於歷史典型走勢，以至於一些投資人開始擔心，今年的強勁表現是否代表提前「借用」了明年的部分或全部漲幅。如果真是如此，那麼2027年可能會像今年強勁一樣，呈現相對疲弱的表現。
好消息是，數據並不支持投資人的這項擔憂。沒有具統計顯著性的證據顯示，期中選舉後的股市強勢表現取決於期中選舉前是否先出現疲弱。
事實上，數據反而略微支持相反的情況，如果市場在期中選舉前同樣表現強勁，選舉後的漲勢可能更加強勁。
1998年就是一個例子。當年是最近一次在8月中旬前，標普500年初至今漲幅與今年相近的期中選舉年。在當年期中選舉日之後的12個月內，標普500上漲22%。
當然，期中選舉後股市並非每次都會出現如此強勁的漲幅。但自1954年標普500成立以來，該指數在期中選舉後12個月從未出現下跌。
相較之下，在總統任期週期中另外3年的相同12個月期間，標普500約有28%的時間出現下跌。
paras_en: Despite a recent pullback in U.S. equities and noticeably higher market volatility, the year’s market performance still far outshines a typical U.S. midterm election year when viewed in historical context.

According to MarketWatch, even after the sharp market drop on August 20, the S&P 500 has risen 11.6% year‑to‑date on price alone; by contrast, the average midterm election year from 1954 to 2022 fell 1.3% at the same point in the cycle.
Analysis notes that in a typical midterm year the market usually bottoms only on the eve of the election, then climbs steadily for most of the following 12 months.
In other words, even if the market were to fall another 11% now, its performance would still not be worse than the same period in a typical midterm year.

Researchers point out that markets tend to be weak before midterms because investors are uncertain about post‑election government policy; that uncertainty often drags stocks down, and once it clears the market rebounds.
Historical data show that which party wins the midterms does not appear to be the key driver of post‑election market direction—once pre‑election uncertainty is resolved, stocks generally rise.

However, this year has not shown the usual pre‑election weakness. In fact, the market’s strength has been so far above the historical norm that some investors worry the rally may have “borrowed” part or all of next year’s gains, potentially leaving 2027 weaker if that’s the case.
The good news is the data do not support that concern. There is no statistically significant evidence that a strong post‑midterm rally depends on pre‑election weakness.
On the contrary, the data slightly favor the opposite: if the market is already strong before the midterms, the post‑election rally may be even stronger.

1998 provides an example. It was the most recent midterm year before mid‑August when the year‑to‑date S&P 500 gain was similar to this year’s, and the index rose 22% in the 12 months after the election that year.

Of course, the market does not always post such a vigorous gain after a midterm, but since the S&P 500’s inception in 1954, it has never posted a decline in the 12 months following a midterm election.
By contrast, in the same 12‑month window during the other three years of a presidential term, the S&P 500 has fallen about 28% of the time.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：輝達財報、華許演說與PCE三大關卡來了
items.title_en: This Week's Trading Notes: Nvidia Earnings, Warsh Speech, and PCE – Three Major Tests Ahead
paras: 美股經歷債市、加密貨幣與個股行情劇烈反轉的一週後，本週將迎來三大關鍵考驗，包括輝達(NVDA-US)財報、聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)首度以主席身分出席傑克森霍爾全球央行年會，以及會前公布的美國通膨與經濟成長數據。這些事件將共同檢驗今年美股上漲的兩項核心假設：人工智慧(AI)需求能否延續，以及利率環境是否仍足以支撐高估值資產。
全球公債殖利率上週大幅攀升，30年期美債殖利率一度觸及2007年以來最高水準，推高家庭與企業借貸成本，也為投入巨額資金興建AI基礎設施的科技公司增加融資壓力。
美國財政部宣布將長天期債券回購規模提高一倍，一度帶動殖利率回落，但行情隔日便大幅逆轉。標普500指數上週走低，距離歷史高點約2%；費城半導體指數週線更下跌約5%，反映殖利率上升已對高估值晶片股造成壓力。
市場波動也延伸至個股與加密貨幣。莫德納(MRNA-US)因癌症疫苗取得重大進展，上週三成為標普500指數表現最佳成分股，隔日卻跌至指數末段班。另一方面，比特幣上週大漲近25%，上週五早盤逼近7.8萬美元，顯示短線資金重新湧向加密貨幣。
若今年推動AI行情的熱錢開始轉向比特幣等其他風險資產，可能削弱科技股多頭動能。因此，本週一連串重要事件將左右資金是否重新回流AI概念股，或持續轉往其他市場。

輝達財報檢驗AI需求成色

輝達預計8月26日公布第二季財報。由於其晶片支撐全球大部分AI基礎設施建設，輝達已不只是一家半導體公司，更被市場視為整個AI生態系統的代表，其業績可反映晶片、資料中心及相關融資需求是否依然強勁。
Arena Private Wealth投資長Erik Kratz表示，當前市場高度依賴AI交易，而輝達無疑是其中最具影響力的企業，財報結果將牽動整個科技產業。從晶片供應商到替資料中心擴建提供資金的金融機構，都可能受到輝達需求展望影響。
輝達近期與六家大型金融機構合作，籌組規模超過5,000億美元的AI基礎設施融資平台，凸顯企業與各國政府競相興建AI資料中心所需的龐大資本。
本週AI與半導體股罕見退居市場焦點之外，輝達財報將讓投資人重新評估AI需求是否足以支撐相關企業的高額投資與估值。市場尤其需要輝達證明AI熱潮依然強勁，而不是在債券殖利率與融資成本升高之際出現急轉彎。
若輝達業績與財測優於預期，可能重新凝聚科技股多頭信心；反之，任何需求放緩、成本上升或資本支出疑慮，都可能使本週已承壓的晶片股面臨新一波賣壓。

華許首次以Fed主席身分赴傑克森霍爾

傑克森霍爾全球央行年會將於8月27日至29日舉行，這也是華許今年5月就任Fed主席後，首度以主席身分出席這項重要央行盛會。市場將密切關注他如何說明貨幣政策框架，以及在不再提供傳統前瞻指引的情況下，如何與投資人溝通。
華許在7月利率會議後並未清楚說明，如果通膨持續居高不下，Fed將採取何種行動，一度引發市場震盪。Aptus Capital Advisors股票主管David Wagner指出，目前政策前景仍缺乏明確性，近期美債劇烈波動正反映投資人的困惑，因此市場目光都將集中在傑克森霍爾。
TritonPoint Wealth投資長Will Sterling預期，華許可能重申以經濟數據為依據的政策框架，要求投資人自行觀察數據並判斷利率走向。這種作法可能增加短期波動，但也能避免市場把Fed的訊號誤解為政策承諾。
Wagner認為，減少前瞻指引長期而言未必是壞事，因為可迫使投資人自行重新評估利率前景。儘管外界擔心華許可能損害Fed聲譽，但上次會議有三名官員對利率決策提出不同意見，也反映Fed內部仍能獨立表達立場。
目前利率市場反映，Fed在9月升息的機率約為35%，到12月前升息的機率則升至66%。華許對通膨、長期殖利率與Fed資產負債表的說法，都可能重新調整市場對升息路徑的預期。

通膨與經濟成長數據提供政策線索

在傑克森霍爾年會前，美國將公布7月個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)及經濟成長報告。PCE是Fed偏好的通膨指標，兩項數據將提供最新的物價與經濟動能圖像，也可能直接影響華許演說的內容及市場反應。
如果通膨依然頑固、經濟成長保持強勁，市場可能進一步提高Fed升息預期，推升美債殖利率並壓迫科技股估值。對AI產業而言，利率上升不僅影響股價，也會增加資料中心、能源設施及晶片投資的融資成本。
相反地，若通膨明顯降溫或經濟成長轉弱，投資人可能降低升息押注，但也會重新擔憂AI需求與企業獲利能否維持。市場因此面臨兩難：數據太強可能推高利率，數據太弱又可能打擊成長預期。
在財政部擴大回購仍無法持續壓低殖利率、短線資金快速流向比特幣之際，下周三大事件可能決定美股多頭能否延續。輝達必須證明AI投資仍有基本面支撐，華許則須讓市場理解Fed的政策框架；PCE與經濟成長數據，則將檢驗兩者面對的是強韌經濟，還是通膨與高利率交織的新風險。
paras_en: After a week of sharp reversals in bonds, crypto and individual stocks, U.S. equities face three key tests this week: Nvidia (NVDA-US) earnings, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s first appearance at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting as chair, and pre‑meeting U.S. inflation and growth data. Together they will test the two core assumptions behind this year’s rally – whether AI demand can endure and whether the rate environment can still support lofty valuations.

Global sovereign‑bond yields surged last week, with the 30‑year U.S. Treasury briefly hitting its highest level since 2007, raising borrowing costs for households and firms and adding financing pressure to tech companies pouring massive capital into AI infrastructure.

The U.S. Treasury announced a doubling of its long‑term bond buy‑back size, briefly pulling yields lower before the market reversed sharply the next day. The S&P 500 slipped last week, about 2% off its all‑time high, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell roughly 5% on the weekly chart, reflecting pressure on high‑multiple chip stocks from rising yields.

Volatility spread to stocks and crypto. Moderna (MRNA‑US) surged to become the top‑performing S&P 500 component after a major cancer‑vaccine breakthrough, then fell to the bottom of the index the next day. Meanwhile Bitcoin rallied nearly 25% last week, briefly approaching $78,000 on Friday morning, showing short‑term capital flowing back into crypto.

If the hot money that has been driving the AI rally starts shifting to Bitcoin and other risk assets, it could sap momentum from tech‑stock bulls. Hence this week’s string of events will decide whether capital returns to AI‑themed equities or continues drifting into other markets.
This week’s trading notes (Aug 24‑28).

Nvidia earnings test AI demand strength. Nvidia is slated to release its Q2 results on Aug 26. Because its chips underpin most global AI infrastructure, Nvidia is seen not just as a semiconductor firm but as a proxy for the entire AI ecosystem, and its performance will signal whether chip, data‑center and related financing demand remain robust.

Erik Kratz, CIO of Arena Private Wealth, said the market is heavily AI‑driven and Nvidia is undoubtedly the most influential player; its earnings will move the whole tech sector. From chip makers to the financial institutions funding data‑center expansion, all could feel the impact of Nvidia’s demand outlook.

Nvidia has recently teamed with six major banks to launch an AI‑infrastructure financing platform exceeding $500 billion, underscoring the massive capital needed as corporations and governments race to build AI data centers.

With AI and semiconductor stocks unusually out of the spotlight this week, Nvidia’s results will force investors to reassess whether AI demand can justify the lofty investments and valuations of related firms. The market especially wants Nvidia to prove the AI boom is still strong, not about to reverse amid higher bond yields and financing costs.

If Nvidia beats expectations, it could rekindle bullish confidence in tech stocks; conversely, any sign of slowing demand, rising costs or cap‑ex doubts could trigger a fresh wave of selling pressure on already‑stressed chip shares.

Warsh’s first appearance as Fed chair at Jackson Hole. The Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting runs Aug 27‑29, marking Warsh’s first attendance as chair since taking the helm in May. Markets will watch how he frames monetary policy and communicates with investors without the traditional forward guidance.

Warsh left the July rate‑policy meeting vague on what the Fed would do if inflation stayed high, sparking market turbulence. David Wagner, head of equities at Aptus Capital Advisors, noted that policy outlook remains unclear and recent Treasury volatility reflects investor confusion, so all eyes will be on Jackson Hole.

Will Sterling, CIO of TritonPoint Wealth, expects Warsh may reiterate a data‑dependent policy framework, urging investors to watch the numbers and form their own rate expectations. This could boost short‑term volatility but avoid misreading Fed signals as firm commitments.

Wagner argues that reducing forward guidance isn’t necessarily bad long‑term, as it forces investors to re‑evaluate rate expectations themselves. Although some worry Warsh could damage the Fed’s credibility, the last meeting saw three officials voice differing views on rate decisions, showing internal independence.

Current rate‑market pricing puts the odds of a September Fed hike at about 35% and the chance of a hike before December at roughly 66%. Warsh’s comments on inflation, long‑term yields and the Fed’s balance sheet could reshape market expectations for the rate‑path.

Inflation and growth data provide policy clues. Ahead of Jackson Hole, the U.S. will release July’s personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index and growth report. PCE is the Fed’s preferred inflation gauge; both numbers will paint the latest price‑and‑growth picture and could directly shape Warsh’s remarks and market reaction.

If inflation remains stubborn and growth stays strong, markets may push Fed‑hike expectations higher, lifting Treasury yields and squeezing tech‑stock valuations. For AI firms, higher rates not only depress stock prices but also raise financing costs for data centers, energy facilities and chip investments.

Conversely, if inflation cools markedly or growth weakens, investors may dial back rate‑hike bets, yet concerns will arise about whether AI demand and corporate earnings can be sustained. The market faces a dilemma: overly strong data could spur rates, while weak data could dent growth expectations.

With the Treasury’s expanded buy‑back unable to keep yields down and short‑term capital sprinting into Bitcoin, next week’s three events will likely decide whether the U.S. equity bull market can persist. Nvidia must prove AI investment still has fundamentals, Warsh must help the market grasp the Fed’s policy framework, and the PCE and growth numbers will test whether the backdrop is a resilient economy or a new risk mix of inflation and high rates.

items.title: 輝達砸60億美元押注「開放權重AI模型」！迎戰中國AI巨頭  或成OpenAI、Anthropi競爭對手
items.title_en: NVIDIA Bets $6 B on Open‑Weight AI Models, Targeting Chinese AI Giants and Potentially Challenging OpenAI and Anthropic
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 正加大對開放權重人工智慧（AI）模型的布局。據知情人士透露，輝達本週與AI新創Poolside達成一項總值60億美元的技術授權協議，並將吸收該公司大批工程師，目標是打造全球最強大的開放權重AI模型之一，進一步挑戰中國DeepSeek、Kimi K3等模型，同時也可能與OpenAI、Anthropic等美國AI龍頭形成更直接的競爭關係。
根據《華爾街日報》報導， Poolside的致股東信指出，輝達將以投前120億美元估值投資Poolside 10億美元，另外支付60億美元取得該公司的技術授權，並延攬大部分工程團隊。
Poolside創辦人Eiso Kant與前GitHub技術長Jason Warner在信中表示，這項交易的目標之一，是讓未來的通用人工智慧（AGI）不會成為少數企業封閉掌控的技術，而是能夠以開放方式由更多人共同建立。
根據知情人士說法，超過100名Poolside員工，包括工程師在內，將加入輝達，並投入輝達自2023年開始發展的Nemotron開放權重模型計畫，協助開發其中規模最大、技術最複雜的模型。
不過，Poolside管理團隊並不會加入輝達。包括Kant、Warner以及營運主管Margarida Garcia在內的公司高層，將繼續從事尚未公開的研究工作。

輝達加碼開放權重AI 正面挑戰中國模型

開放權重模型可以免費下載，開發者也能根據特定需求進行修改，因此通常具備較低的使用成本與更高的客製化彈性。
相較之下，目前美國AI產業投入更多資源發展的是封閉式模型。OpenAI、Anthropic以及Google(GOOGL-US) 等業者的主要模型，均不會向開發者公開完整的模型權重或原始碼。
這也逐漸成為美中AI競爭中的一項重要問題。由於美國AI公司過去並未將開放式模型置於最高優先位置，市場開始擔心，全球企業與國家可能轉向中國開發的開放權重模型。
輝達執行長黃仁勳長期支持開放權重模型，而近半年來，公司更明顯加快相關布局，試圖因應中國開放模型快速崛起的趨勢。
今年3月，輝達成立Nemotron Coalition，集結Mistral、Thinking Machines Lab及Perplexity等主要開放模型開發商。輝達表示，成員將共享資料、專業知識及運算資源。
同月，《華爾街日報》報導，另一家獲輝達支持、並參與Nemotron Coalition的新創Reflection AI，因其先進的開放權重模型而被投資人形容為「西方的DeepSeek」，當時正進行一輪大規模募資談判，計畫以250億美元估值籌募25億美元。
黃仁勳上月也首次在社群平台X發文，並發布題為「Open Weights and American AI Leadership」的公開信，強調美國能否贏得AI競賽，關鍵不在於單一最先進AI模型，而在於能否建立一個強大的開放生態系，並將AI技術擴散至各個產業。

DeepSeek掀起震撼 輝達押注開放模型競賽

中國AI模型的快速崛起，是輝達加速布局開放權重AI的重要背景。
2025年1月，DeepSeek發布首款低成本開放權重模型，引發美國科技股劇烈震盪。市場當時將其視為中國AI技術快速追趕美國的訊號，創投家Marc Andreessen更形容這是AI領域的「史普尼克時刻」（Sputnik moment）。
此後，美中AI競賽持續升溫。中國陸續出現新的AI業者，並開發出與美國最先進AI技術差距僅數個月的開放模型，其中包括Moonshot旗下的Kimi，以及Z.AI的GLM系列模型等。
如今，輝達透過取得Poolside技術授權並延攬其大部分工程人才，押注在未來一年內打造出能與全球頂尖AI模型競爭的Nemotron版本。
本月稍早，輝達發布 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，這是一款較為「輕量化」的開放權重模型，目前公司也正在開發該系列迄今規模最大的版本。
市場傳聞，這款最大版本的訓練參數可能超過1兆個，使其躋身史上規模最大的人工智慧（AI）模型之列。不過，目前仍有部分中國開放權重模型的規模更大。
此外，與Poolside的交易也讓輝達面臨一項微妙的競爭關係。目前OpenAI、Anthropic等大型AI實驗室不僅是輝達最重要的AI晶片客戶之一，同時也是封閉式AI模型的主要開發商。隨著輝達開始自行強化Nemotron等開放權重模型，雙方的合作關係也可能逐漸加入競爭因素。
此外，輝達支持的其他開放模型開發商也可能與Nemotron形成競爭。
部分專家指出，大型AI實驗室本身也正在開發客製化AI晶片，用於支撐旗下模型的訓練與運算，因此這些企業與輝達之間其實早已存在一定程度的直接競爭。

Poolside曾因算力資金不足陷入困境

值得注意的是，Poolside與輝達雖然早已有合作關係，但這次交易是在最近幾週內快速敲定。
輝達向Poolside提出投資及技術授權交易的時間，恰逢這家新創公司發布最新模型「Laguna S」前後。該模型已成為西方市場最受歡迎的開放權重模型之一。
Poolside發布的股東信也提到，公司2025年曾經歷一次募資失敗，這場挫折促使公司重新檢視自身發展方向，並間接促成與輝達的這筆交易。
信中寫道：「去年年底，我們有6週的時間籌集20億美元，用於支付一座將於1月啟用、配備4萬顆GB300的運算叢集。」其中，GB300是輝達常見的AI模型訓練伺服器類型。
Poolside表示，公司未能在期限內完成募資，因此失去了這座運算叢集。
Poolside管理層在信中表示，公司「重新振作，回到工作崗位」，但很快便意識到，如果無法取得所需資金及資料中心資源，公司的運算能力最快可能在明年就會耗盡。
Poolside在信中指出，輝達是理想的合作夥伴，其中一項原因在於，輝達面臨的運算基礎設施及現金限制相對較少。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) is intensifying its push into open‑weight artificial intelligence (AI) models. According to sources, NVIDIA this week struck a $6 billion technology licensing deal with AI startup Poolside and will absorb a large portion of the company’s engineers, aiming to build one of the world’s most powerful open‑weight AI models and further challenge Chinese models such as DeepSeek and Kimi K3, while also potentially entering a more direct rivalry with U.S. AI leaders like OpenAI and Anthropic.

The Wall Street Journal reported that Poolside’s letter to shareholders said NVIDIA will invest $1 billion in Poolside at a pre‑money valuation of $12 billion, and will pay $6 billion for a technology license, while also hiring most of the engineering team.

Poolside founders Eiso Kant and former GitHub CTO Jason Warner wrote that one goal of the transaction is to ensure that future artificial general intelligence (AGI) does not become a closed technology controlled by a few firms, but rather can be built openly by a broader community.

Sources say more than 100 Poolside employees, including engineers, will join NVIDIA and be assigned to NVIDIA’s Nemotron open‑weight model program, which began in 2023, to help develop its largest and most technically complex model.

However, Poolside’s management team will not join NVIDIA. The company’s senior leadership, including Kant, Warner and COO Margarida Garcia, will continue work on research that has not yet been disclosed.

NVIDIA is ramping up its open‑weight AI efforts to directly challenge Chinese models. Open‑weight models can be downloaded for free, and developers can modify them to suit specific needs, resulting in lower usage costs and greater customization flexibility.

By contrast, the U.S. AI industry is currently pouring more resources into closed‑source models. Major models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google (GOOGL‑US) do not make full model weights or source code publicly available to developers.

This has become an increasingly important issue in the U.S.–China AI rivalry. Because U.S. firms have not prioritized open models, the market worries that enterprises and nations worldwide may shift toward open‑weight models developed in China.
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has long championed open‑weight models, and in the past six months the company has noticeably accelerated related investments to counter the rapid rise of Chinese open models.

In March, NVIDIA formed the Nemotron Coalition, bringing together leading open‑model developers such as Mistral, Thinking Machines Lab and Perplexity. NVIDIA said coalition members will share data, expertise and compute resources.

That same month, the Wall Street Journal reported that Reflection AI, a startup backed by NVIDIA and part of the Nemotron Coalition, was being described by investors as the “Western DeepSeek” because of its advanced open‑weight model, and was negotiating a large fundraising round aiming to raise $2.5 billion at a $250 billion valuation.

Jensen Huang also posted on X last month, publishing an open letter titled “Open Weights and American AI Leadership,” emphasizing that America’s chance to win the AI race depends not on a single cutting‑edge model but on building a robust open ecosystem that spreads AI technology across industries.
DeepSeek’s shockwave underscores why NVIDIA is betting on open‑model competition. The rapid emergence of Chinese AI models is a key backdrop for NVIDIA’s accelerated open‑weight AI strategy.

In January 2025, DeepSeek released its first low‑cost open‑weight model, sparking sharp swings in U.S. tech stocks. The market saw it as a signal that Chinese AI was quickly catching up to the United States, and venture capitalist Marc Andreessen called it a “Sputnik moment” for AI.

Since then, the U.S.–China AI competition has heated up. New Chinese AI firms have emerged, releasing open models that are only a few months behind the most advanced U.S. technologies, including Moonshot’s Kimi and Z.AI’s GLM series.
Now, by licensing Poolside’s technology and hiring most of its engineers, NVIDIA is betting it can deliver a Nemotron version within a year that can compete with the world’s top AI models.
Earlier this month NVIDIA unveiled Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a more “lightweight” open‑weight model, and the company is already working on the largest version in the series to date.
Rumors suggest the largest version could exceed one trillion parameters, placing it among the biggest AI models ever built, although some Chinese open‑weight models are reportedly even larger.

The Poolside deal also puts NVIDIA in a delicate competitive position. Today, OpenAI, Anthropic and other large AI labs are not only among NVIDIA’s biggest AI‑chip customers but also the primary developers of closed‑source models. As NVIDIA strengthens its own open‑weight offerings, the partnership could gradually acquire a competitive edge.
Additionally, other open‑model developers backed by NVIDIA may end up competing with Nemotron.

Some experts note that large AI labs are themselves developing custom AI chips to support training and inference for their models, meaning they already have a degree of direct competition with NVIDIA.

Poolside previously ran into trouble due to insufficient compute funding, a point worth noting as the two firms have long collaborated, but this transaction was finalized quickly over the past few weeks.

NVIDIA’s proposal to invest in and license technology from Poolside came just as the startup was about to launch its latest model, “Laguna S,” which has become one of the most popular open‑weight models in Western markets.
Poolside’s shareholder letter also mentioned that the company experienced a failed fundraising round in 2025, prompting a reassessment of its direction and indirectly leading to the deal with NVIDIA.

The letter said, “At the end of last year we spent six weeks raising $2 billion to fund a compute cluster slated to go live in January with 40,000 GB300 units.” GB300 is a common NVIDIA AI‑model training server type.
Poolside noted it missed the fundraising deadline and therefore lost the planned compute cluster.

In the letter, Poolside’s leadership wrote that the company “has regrouped and is back at work,” but quickly realized that without the needed capital and data‑center resources, its compute capacity could be exhausted as early as next year.
Poolside concluded that NVIDIA is an ideal partner because it faces relatively fewer constraints on compute infrastructure and cash resources.

items.title: 《大賣空》貝瑞拋售阿里巴巴、稱「股價太貴」！轉手買入「這一股」
items.title_en: Michael Burry Sells Alibaba, Calls Its Stock Too Expensive, Switches to JD
paras: 以押注美國房市崩盤聞名的《大賣空》原型投資人貝瑞（Michael Burry）批評阿里巴巴(09988-HK) 股價估值過高，並透露自己近期已退出這家中國科技巨頭的持股，轉而在其競爭對手京東集團(09618-HK) 建立一筆「大額」持倉。
根據《彭博》報導，貝瑞在Substack發文表示，他原本計畫在一、兩個月後將大部分資金重新投入阿里巴巴，但如今已改變想法。他指出，除非阿里巴巴股價跌至目前的一半，否則他不會重新產生投資興趣。
貝瑞是Scion Capital Management創辦人，因在2008年全球金融危機前押注美國房市下跌而成名。
他此次發表上述看法之際，阿里巴巴才宣布計畫透過發行新股籌集約800億港元（約102億美元），為AI投資提供資金。若完成，這將成為香港市場有史以來規模最大的上市公司增發集資案。
對於阿里巴巴透過發行新股籌資的做法，貝瑞直言自己「我無法認同發行新股這件事」，並預期公司投入資本報酬率仍將持續下滑。
阿里巴巴近期公布截至6月底的季度財報，獲利較去年同期大幅下滑75%。隨著公司加大AI相關資本支出，進一步加劇了投資者對中國科技業未來回報的擔憂。
股價表現同樣承受壓力。阿里巴巴美國存託憑證(BABA-US) 今年以來累計下跌18.6%，僅上週五（21日）單日就下挫8.6%；在香港掛牌的阿里巴巴股價今年迄今也下跌13.9%。
值得注意的是，貝瑞今年4月才透露建立阿里巴巴的新持倉。
阿里巴巴則在週日（23日）另行宣布，此次增發新股的定價為每股112.70港元，相較之下，香港股市上週五收盤價為123港元。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Michael Burry, the original investor behind the book "The Big Short" known for betting on the collapse of the U.S. housing market, criticized Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. (09988-HK) for being overvalued and revealed that he has recently exited his holdings in the Chinese tech giant, instead building a large position in its competitor JD.com (09618-HK).

According to Bloomberg, Burry wrote on Substack that he had originally planned to reinvest most of his capital back into Alibaba in one or two months, but has now changed his mind. He said he would not be interested in re-entering the company unless its stock price fell to about half of its current level.
Burry is the founder of Scion Capital Management and became famous for betting on the decline of the U.S. housing market before the 2008 global financial crisis.

At the time Burry made these remarks, Alibaba had just announced plans to raise about HK$80 billion (US$10.2 billion) by issuing new shares to fund AI investments. If completed, it would be the largest share‑issuance capital‑raising deal ever in the Hong Kong market.
Regarding Alibaba’s new‑share issuance, Burry said, “I cannot endorse the act of issuing new shares,” and expects the company’s capital‑return rate to continue to decline.

Alibaba recently released its Q2 2024 earnings, showing a 75% drop in profit year‑on‑year. The company’s increased AI‑related capital expenditures have further heightened investors’ concerns about the future returns of Chinese technology firms.

The stock has also been under pressure. Alibaba’s U.S. Depositary Receipts (BABA‑US) have fallen 18.6% year‑to‑date, dropping 8.6% on Friday the 21st; the Hong Kong‑listed Alibaba shares have fallen 13.9% so far this year.
It is worth noting that Burry only disclosed his new Alibaba position in April of this year.
Alibaba announced on Sunday the 23rd that the new share issuance would be priced at HK$112.70 per share, compared with the Hong Kong market closing price of HK$123 on Friday.

items.title: 800億港元配股+《大賣空》原型清倉施壓  阿里巴巴今港股早盤崩逾9%
items.title_en: Alibaba Shares Drop Over 9% in Hong Kong Opening Amid 80 Billion HKD Rights Issue and Pressure from 'The Big Short' Protagonist
paras: 阿里巴巴今(24)日在港股大幅開低逾9%，開盤報每股113.1港元，最低來到110.8港元，主要受到發行新股計畫，以及遭到市場知名投資人大幅清倉的影響。
阿里巴巴在週末期間宣布，打算以每股112.70港元的價格配售7.1億股新股份，募資總額約800億港元(約合102億美元)，扣除佣金及相關開支後，配售所得淨額約797億港元，將100%用於AI基礎設施建設和總成本
配售價較阿里巴巴上週五(21日)港股收盤價折讓約8.4%，為阿里巴巴2019年在香港上市以來首次進行股權配售。
市場人士分析，短期籌碼供給增加疊加折價定價，料將持續壓抑股價表現，週三(26日)交割完成前，配售價附近或成為多空激戰戰場。
本次新股配售對象為美國境外的非美國專業及法人機構，所得款項淨額將100%用於投資全棧AI能力與基礎建設。
不過，知名投資人、電影《大賣空》原型Michael Burry認為，阿里巴巴股票估值過高，並透露最近清倉這家中國科技巨頭的股份，轉而大幅增持京東。
Burry週日(23日)在Substack上貼文說：「我原本打算一、兩個月後將大部分資金移回阿里，但現在不會了。阿里巴巴股價必須下跌一半，我才會重新感興趣。」
paras_en: Alibaba opened more than 9% lower in Hong Kong today (24), trading at HK$113.1 per share at the open and falling to a low of HK$110.8, largely due to the announcement of a new share issuance and the large-scale liquidation by a well-known market investor.

During the weekend, Alibaba announced plans to issue 710 million new shares at HK$112.70 each, raising roughly HK$80 billion (about US$10.2 billion). After fees and related expenses, the net proceeds are expected to be about HK$79.7 billion, which will be used 100% for AI infrastructure and overall costs.
The offering price is about 8.4% below Alibaba's closing price on Friday (21), marking the first equity rights issue since Alibaba's 2019 listing in Hong Kong.

Market analysts say that the short-term increase in supply combined with the discounted pricing will likely continue to suppress the stock price, and that the price range around the offering price could become a battleground for buyers and sellers before settlement on Wednesday (26).

The new shares are being offered to non-U.S. professional and institutional investors outside the United States, and the net proceeds will be used 100% to invest in full-stack AI capabilities and infrastructure.

However, well-known investor and the inspiration for the film "The Big Short," Michael Burry, believes Alibaba's valuation is too high and has disclosed that he has recently liquidated his holdings in the Chinese tech giant, instead increasing his stake in JD.com.

Burry wrote on Substack on Sunday (23): "I originally planned to move most of my money back into Alibaba in one or two months, but I won't do that now. Alibaba's stock price has to drop by half before I become interested again."

items.title: 美加關稅談判破局 凌晨1點！川普發飆了
paras: 您沒看錯，周日（23日）凌晨1點，美國總統川普還沒有睡，向加拿大開炮了。
川普在社交平台發洩不滿：「加拿大想享受（作為美國）一個州的好處，卻又不願成為美國的一個州！！！多年來，他們還對我國偉大農民徵收巨額關稅。夠了！！！」
短短一句話，六個感嘆號！
看了一下，具體發布時間，凌晨1:06。
日理萬機的川普，久久不能入睡。
長夜，最容易滋生不加掩飾的情緒，螢幕一端的一句怒吼，牽動的卻是兩個國家間戲劇性博弈。
美國不想姑息了，對加拿大，就是要加徵沉重關稅，就是要讓加拿大成為美國第51個州。
第二天醒來，具體時間，上午9:11，川普又重發了一遍上面這條推文。
總統先生的怒氣，且沒消呢。
反覆重申的言辭，既是對外施壓，也是對內表明立場，情緒背後藏著清晰談判籌碼。
加拿大那邊，情緒更加悲憤。
加拿大總理卡尼此前宣布，撤回與美國的談判，因為「美國要求太多，給的太少」；至於美國加徵50%關稅，加拿大以牙還牙，「1美元對1美元」。
為什麼加拿大不願意談了？
應該是美加談得差不多的時候，美國又突然加碼了：
1，要求加拿大接受對第三國貿易的限制，也就是說，加拿大以後與誰簽署貿易協議，美國說了算；
2，要求擁有對加拿大礦產資源出售掌控權，也就是說，加拿大礦產賣給誰，也是美國說了算。
這還怎麼談？
答應了，加拿大就不再是一個獨立國家了。更何況，美國的要求，總是一再加碼。
談判底線一旦被不斷突破，妥協就不再是和解，而是一步步交出主權。
綜合加拿大媒體的報導，美國對加拿大的核心要求，不止於上面兩條，應該是13條，大致如下：
1.對戰略性基礎設施合作擁有否決權
加拿大必須將基礎設施領域（港口、電信、能源管道、電網）的重大外資項目提交美加聯合審查委員會，這相當於讓美國對加拿大境內外資投資擁有實際否決權。
2.預先對非美國國家實施貿易限制
加拿大必須配合美國實施制裁、出口管制，並對第三國徵收進口關稅，放棄制定獨立對外貿易政策的權利。
3.關鍵礦產領域司法管轄權優先
美國要求對加拿大北部出產的所有未精煉關鍵礦產（例如鋰、鎳、鈷、鈾）享有優先購買權，並鎖定定價，限制加拿大本土加工，同時限制向其他國家出口。
4.廢除數位服務稅與《在線新聞法案》
加拿大必須撤銷相關法案：該法案原本要求境外科技平台針對加拿大用戶產生的營收納稅，並向加拿大新聞出版商支付補償。
5.取消文化與語言保護政策
美方要求廢除加拿大內容配額制度（加制內容配額）、修訂《在線流媒體法案》，免除美國商品及數字服務需遵守各省語言法規的義務，目標直指魁北克的法語保護政策。
6.廢除 「加拿大優先」 公共採購規則
加拿大各級政府必須給予美國企業平等參與公共基建項目投標的資格，禁止優待本土或加拿大供應商。
7.拆除農業保護保障機制
美國要求加拿大取消乳製品、蛋類、家禽行業的供應管理體系，強制採用美國化學品與農藥標準。
8.單方面修改汽車行業相關規則
重型整車廠及汽車零部件行業不再享受關稅減免；同時修改相關規則，促使整車製造崗位轉移至美國本土。
9.延長醫藥專利保護期限
美國要求延長境外藥企的數據獨佔保護期，推遲仿製藥在加拿大上市，推高各省醫療開支。
10.加拿大能源優先供給美國
要求加拿大向美國出口原油、天然氣、水電、核能時，保障優先分配供應量，並鎖定價格。
11.具有約束力的軍事與北極相關義務
加拿大必須達到特定國防開支標準，且相關開支需用於採購美國製造軍備，用於北極監測以及北美防空聯合司令部（NORAD）升級項目。
12.下調海關與小額免稅門檻
美方要求降低跨境電商徵稅門檻，讓美國零售商可以免稅向加拿大消費者銷售商品，損害加拿大本土企業利益。
13.爭端解決機制調整
美國推動建立更強有力的投資者 - 國家爭端解決機制，允許境外企業起訴加拿大法律法規。
美國步步緊逼，不僅加拿大總理憤怒，加拿大社會更是一片譁然。
民調數據顯示，多數加拿大人認為，與俄羅斯等國相比，美國對加拿大安全構成更大威脅；三分之二受訪者支持政府採取更強硬立場；認為美國值得信任的加拿大人，不到四分之一。

items.title: 金價衝破4600、美債破40兆美元 資金開始瘋狂流向Halo資產
items.title_en: Gold Surpasses $4,600, U.S. Treasuries Hit $40 Trillion as Funds Rush to Halo Assets
paras: 國際金價上周五(21日)站上每盎司4600美元，30年期美債殖利率同週觸及5.337%，回到2007年金融海嘯前高點，而與此同時，美國財政部宣布聯邦債務餘額首破40兆美元。
當「最鋒利的矛(AI)」利潤待兌、「最堅固的盾(美債)」顯露裂縫，資金轉向低淘汰率、難複製的Halo資產如油氣、電力、礦產、港鐵與核心地段不動產皆屬此類。
《博聞財經》報導，從去年底迄今，深圳灣豪宅累計吸金約550億元，新房均價每平方公尺15—20萬元，最高單價39.86萬元，買家約七成是90後，晶片、AI創辦人及技術合夥人成主力，95後創一代也現身市場。
香港新世界旗下豪宅產品線PAVILIA COLLECTION首次進軍中國大陸，落子南山大沙河、深圳灣上游，定名「THE BAY PAVILIA灣上雲啟｜灣滶」，預計第三季推出銷售檔期，2000平方呎起跳，兩梯兩戶。
分析人士認為，全球避險情緒不會因為企業單季財報消散，核心城市不可再生的濱水豪宅，正從「消費品」重估為「主權信用風險對沖」的實體截面。
報導指出，當美債破40兆、美元信用鬆動、AI與美債同時顯出脆弱時，資金不再只買「故事」，而想握住一種物理上切下來就屬於你、且供給被海岸線鎖死的那一塊真實世界，深圳灣豪宅就是這種「被切出來的樣本」並其兼具著以下三層功能：一是Halo資產(重資產、低淘汰、難複製)；二是對美債信用風險的實物對沖；三是宏觀經濟動盪裡可觀測、可抵押、可傳代的「實體切片」，而不是財報上的數字。
paras_en: International gold prices topped $4,600 per ounce on Friday (21st) last week, while the 30‑year U.S. Treasury yield reached 5.337%, returning to its pre‑2007 financial crisis high, and at the same time the U.S. Treasury announced that the federal debt balance had broken the $40 trillion threshold.

When the "sharpest spear (AI)" profits are pending and the "sturdest shield (Treasuries)" shows cracks, capital shifts to low‑turnover, hard‑to‑replicate Halo assets such as oil and gas, electricity, mining, railways, and core‑location real estate.

According to a report by Bo Wen Finance, Shenzhen Bay luxury homes have attracted about CNY 55 billion in capital since the end of last year, with new‑home average prices ranging from CNY 150,000 to 200,000 per square meter, a peak unit price of CNY 398,600, and roughly 70% of buyers are post‑90s, chip and AI founders and technical partners, with some post‑95s also entering the market.

Hong Kong New World’s luxury product line PAVILIA COLLECTION has entered mainland China for the first time, launching in Nanshan Dashihe and upstream Shenzhen Bay, named "THE BAY PAVILIA Bay Shang Yun Qi | Bay Dao", with sales expected to start in Q3, starting at 2,000 square feet, two lifts, two units.

Analysts believe that global safe‑haven sentiment will not dissipate due to a single quarter’s corporate earnings, and that core cities’ non‑renewable waterfront luxury homes are being re‑rated from "consumer goods" to "physical hedges against sovereign credit risk."

The report notes that when U.S. Treasuries break $40 trillion, dollar credit loosens, and both AI and Treasuries show fragility, capital no longer buys only "stories" but seeks a tangible slice of the real world that is physically yours and whose supply is locked by the coastline; Shenzhen Bay luxury homes are such a "cut‑out sample," offering three layers of function: first, Halo assets (heavy, low‑turnover, hard‑to‑replicate); second, a physical hedge against Treasury credit risk; third, a tangible, observable, collateralizable, generational slice of the macro‑economic turbulence, not just numbers on a financial statement.

items.title: 9秒32！深圳榮耀「閃電」機器人打破博爾特紀錄  峰值每秒14.5公尺重寫人類百米極限
items.title_en: 9.32 Seconds! Shenzhen Glory “Lightning” Robot Breaks Bolt Record, Peak Speed 14.5 m/s Redefines Human 100‑Metre Limit
paras: 2009年8月16日，博爾特在柏林跑出9秒58的人類百公尺極限，這項紀錄在17年後被來自深圳的「閃電」改寫。
上周六(22日)，在北京國家速滑館「冰絲帶」外的第二屆世界人形機器人運動會備賽環節，榮耀自研人形機器人「閃電」以9秒32衝線，峰值速度14.5公尺/秒，將人類世界紀錄提升0.26秒。
事實上，今年4月亦莊半馬，它50分26秒完賽，從半馬每秒7-8公尺到百公尺14.5公尺/秒，完成耐力到爆發力的跨越。榮耀CEO李健稱之為「自我突破的勝利時刻」。
專家指出，「閃電」跑得比人快，靠的是硬體；腿長從0.95公尺加至1.05公尺，步幅拉大，加上內部輕量化拓樸減重，關節扭矩與反應全面提升，且百米用髖部攝影機純視覺防偏，400公尺加頭部雷達。
誕生於深圳坪山榮耀基地的「閃電」，移植了Magic系列的青海湖電池(高能量密度+脈衝大電流)與液冷散熱架構，解決續航與熱控難題。這些經極限錘煉的技術將完整回歸Magic9系列，實現「冠軍同源」。
榮耀目前擁有近1萬名研發人員，在坪山的智慧製造產業園，生產線能做到28.5秒下線一台手機。這種精密製造能力、供應鏈掌控力，以及對電源管理、熱設計、精密結構件的理解，正是機器人賽道的關鍵能力。
本屆賽事吸引全球16國666支隊伍、2056台機器人參賽，規模翻倍。「閃電」作為唯一機器人運動員代表宣誓。2025年深圳機器人群營收超379億元、增加34.3%，服務型機器人產量佔全國近43%，產業鏈為全中國最完整
paras_en: On August 16, 2009, Usain Bolt ran 9.58 seconds in Berlin, setting the human 100‑metre benchmark that stood for 17 years until it was eclipsed by the “Lightning” robot from Shenzhen.

Last Saturday (the 22nd), during the qualifying round of the second World Humanoid Robot Games held outside the “Ice Ribbon” at Beijing’s National Speed Skating Hall, Glory’s self‑developed humanoid robot “Lightning” crossed the finish line in 9.32 seconds, reaching a peak speed of 14.5 metres per second and improving the human world record by 0.26 seconds.

In fact, in April this year the robot also completed a half‑marathon in 50 minutes 26 seconds, accelerating from a half‑marathon pace of 7‑8 m/s to 14.5 m/s over 100 m, demonstrating a leap from endurance to explosive power. Glory CEO Li Jian called it a “victory moment of self‑breakthrough.”

Experts note that “Lightning” runs faster than humans thanks to its hardware: leg length was increased from 0.95 m to 1.05 m, enlarging stride, while internal lightweight topology reduces mass, and joint torque and response have been fully upgraded. The 100‑m run uses a hip‑mounted camera for pure visual bias correction, and a head‑mounted radar assists over 400 m.

Born at Glory’s Pingshan base in Shenzhen, “Lightning” incorporates Magic series Qinghai‑Lake batteries (high energy density and high‑pulse current) and a liquid‑cooling heat‑dissipation architecture, solving endurance and thermal‑management challenges. These rugged‑tested technologies will be fully returned to the Magic 9 series, achieving a “champion‑grade lineage.”

Glory now employs nearly 10,000 R&D staff. In its smart‑manufacturing park in Pingshan, the production line can finish a mobile phone every 28.5 seconds. This precision manufacturing capability, supply‑chain control, and deep expertise in power management, thermal design, and precision structures are the key strengths for the robotics arena.

The current competition attracted 666 teams from 16 countries, fielding 2,056 robots—double the scale of previous editions. “Lightning” served as the sole robot athlete representative in the oath‑taking ceremony. In 2025, Shenzhen’s robot sector is projected to generate revenue exceeding 37.9 billion yuan, up 34.3%, with service robots accounting for nearly 43% of national output, making the industry chain the most complete in China.

items.title: 標普500恐跌15%至20%？策略師警告：美債殖利率逼近5%恐引爆股市「去風險」
items.title_en: S&P 500 Could Fall 15% to 20%? Strategists Warn: Near‑5% Treasury Yields May Trigger Market 'Risk‑Off'
paras: 若美國長天期公債殖利率持續走高，市場情勢可能很快進一步惡化。市場研究機構MRB Partners全球策略合夥人Phillip Colmar警告，若10年期美債殖利率持續走高，標普500指數甚至可能回落15%至20%。
根據《Business Insider》報導，Colmar本週在給客戶的報告中指出，長天期美債殖利率的上升，已讓股市處於爆發一波「去風險」行情的臨界點。
上週10年期美債殖利率一度升破4.7%，30年期殖利率也突破5.2%。債券投資人日益擔心政府債務持續攀升、經濟成長預期強勁，以及美伊戰爭持續帶來的通膨壓力。
Colmar上週五（21日）表示，如果長天期公債殖利率持續走高，10年期殖利率接近5%大關，可能讓投資人受到驚嚇，進而引發標普500指數下跌15%至20%。
談到10年期公債殖利率時，他表示：「只要市場看起來殖利率還會繼續上升，而且沒有任何力量能阻止它，就可能在殖利率突破5%之前，引發一波去風險事件。」
Colmar目前並未預測美債殖利率下一步確切走勢，但他表示，目前投資立場仍偏向支持經濟成長。
不過，他指出，美國財政部本週試圖壓低長天期公債殖利率的措施，反而可能適得其反，導致殖利率進一步走高。
美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）日前表示，財政部將擴大公債回購規模，藉此降低市場上的債券供給，希望進一步壓低殖利率。
但Colmar認為，這項措施可能讓市場產生一種印象，即川普政府試圖壓低公債殖利率，卻沒有處理殖利率上升的根本原因，也就是市場對通膨的疑慮。
Colmar表示，由於這項措施並未與聯準會（Fed）協調，也可能向市場釋放出財政部正在恐慌的訊號。聯準會此前已表示，希望讓所持政府公債到期後自然退出資產負債表。
Colmar表示，市場很容易察覺到政策制定者的「恐慌」。

為何美債殖利率上升會打擊股市？

長天期美債殖利率走高對股市的衝擊，主要來自兩個層面。
首先，殖利率上升通常會對成長型股票造成壓力。原因在於，投資人會將長期公債所提供的無風險報酬率，與股票市場未來具有不確定性的長期報酬進行比較。
由於目前市場很大一部分估值建立在AI將提升生產力的長期預期上，一旦AI交易陷入停滯，可能進一步拖累整體市場。
其次，政府公債殖利率上升也會影響AI企業的借貸成本。這些企業目前正投入大量資本建設AI基礎設施，而更高的融資成本將壓縮投資資本的整體報酬率，並降低企業獲利。
Colmar表示，AI企業目前承受著巨大的投資變現壓力，市場對其未來獲利的預期也已非常高。若借貸成本持續上升，企業實現市場預期的投資回報所需時間將被拉長，將促使投資人下修獲利預期，並要求企業更加嚴格控管資本支出，進而導致股價下跌。
他表示：「最終可能形成一個預期落差：AI本身或許仍是一個不錯的題材，但市場預期實在太高，企業如今已無法達到這些預期。」
對於擔心公債殖利率進一步上升的投資人，Colmar也提出幾項可以強化投資組合的策略。
其中一項做法是降低AI股票的曝險，同時增加防禦型產業的配置，例如醫療保健類股。相較於其他傳統防禦型產業，醫療保健類股通常對利率變化的敏感度較低。
此外，他表示，金融類股在利率走高的環境下通常也有較佳表現。
可用於布局上述投資方向的基金，包括先鋒醫療股指數ETF(VHT-US) 及SPDR 金融類股ETF(XLF-US) 。
paras_en: If U.S. long‑term Treasury yields continue to rise, market conditions could deteriorate rapidly. MRB Partners global strategist Phillip Colmar warned that if the 10‑year Treasury yield keeps climbing, the S&P 500 could fall 15% to 20%.
According to Business Insider, Colmar noted in a client report this week that the rise in long‑term Treasury yields has pushed the market to the brink of a 'risk‑off' wave.

Last week the 10‑year Treasury yield briefly breached 4.7%, and the 30‑year yield surpassed 5.2%. Bond investors are increasingly worried about rising government debt, strong growth expectations, and ongoing inflationary pressure from the U.S.–Iran conflict.
Colmar said on Friday (the 21st) that if long‑term Treasury yields keep climbing and the 10‑year yield nears the 5% threshold, investors could be shocked, triggering a 15% to 20% drop in the S&P 500.
When discussing the 10‑year Treasury yield, he said: 'If the market believes yields will keep rising and nothing can stop them, a risk‑off event could erupt before the 5% barrier is breached.'
Colmar does not yet predict the exact next move of Treasury yields, but he remains supportive of economic growth in his current investment stance.
However, he pointed out that the Treasury's recent attempts to lower long‑term yields may backfire, pushing yields higher.
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent recently said the Treasury would expand bond repurchase programs to reduce supply and lower yields.
But Colmar believes this move may create the impression that the Trump administration is trying to suppress yields without addressing the root cause—market concerns about inflation.

Colmar noted that because this measure was not coordinated with the Fed, it could signal Treasury panic to the market. The Fed has previously said it intends to let held government bonds mature and exit the balance sheet naturally.
Colmar said markets are quick to detect policymakers' 'panic'.
Why rising Treasury yields hurt the stock market? The impact of long‑term yields on equities comes from two main angles.
First, rising yields typically pressure growth stocks. Investors compare the risk‑free return from long‑term bonds to the uncertain long‑term returns of the equity market.
Because a large portion of current valuations is built on the expectation that AI will boost productivity, a slowdown in AI trading could further drag down the overall market.

Second, higher Treasury yields also raise borrowing costs for AI firms. These companies are investing heavily in AI infrastructure, and higher financing costs compress overall investment returns and reduce profitability.

Colmar said AI firms are under significant pressure to monetize investments, and market expectations for their future earnings are already very high. If borrowing costs continue to rise, the time needed to achieve expected returns lengthens, prompting investors to cut earnings forecasts and demand tighter capital discipline, leading to falling stock prices.
He added: 'Ultimately, a gap may form between expectations and reality: AI may still be a good theme, but the market's expectations are too high for firms to meet.'
For investors worried about further yield increases, Colmar suggested several strategies to strengthen portfolios.

One approach is to reduce exposure to AI stocks while increasing allocation to defensive sectors, such as healthcare. Compared to other traditional defensive industries, healthcare stocks are generally less sensitive to interest rate changes.
Additionally, he noted that financial stocks tend to perform better in a rising‑rate environment.
Funds that can be used to position toward these investment themes include the Vanguard Health Care ETF (VHT-US) and the SPDR Financial Select Sector ETF (XLF-US).

items.title: 美國變了！加總理強硬掀桌  專家：卡尼藏有兩張王牌 墨國恐成美加關稅戰直接受害者
items.title_en: The U.S. Has Changed! Prime Minister Trudeau’s Hardline Move Shakes the Table: Experts Say Trudeau Holds Two Trump Cards, Mexico May Become the Direct Victim of a U.S.-Canada Tariff War
paras: 美東時間周六(22日)凌晨00:01，美國依據《1930年關稅法》第338條對約200億美元加拿大商品加徵50%關稅正式生效，涵蓋紅酒、啤酒、曲棍球棒、水泥、膠合板、牛奶、部分服裝等數百項特定產品。
數小時後，加拿大總理卡尼發表逾20分鐘全國電視講話，宣布暫停談判、召回代表團，並明示9月8日起對美啟動等額報復性關稅，範圍含乳製品、鋼鐵、家電、電子產品、紙漿造紙等。
卡尼說：「當你受到攻擊時，你就處於戰爭狀態——我們確實遭到了攻擊。美國已經變了，有時它的簽字是用鉛筆寫的。」
談判並非沒有接近過終點。8月18日川普暫緩三天徵稅，勒布朗與美國貿易代表格里爾在華盛頓連談三日，加國已釋出取消數字服務稅、松綁各省禁售美酒、戈迪·豪大橋部分通行費讓利等善意。 但21日下午情勢急轉：格里爾皺眉走進會議室，幾小時後談判崩潰。
卡尼歸咎於美方臨界一腳拋出三道越界條款：限制加國與第三國簽新貿易協議的能力；干涉法語、文化保護等主權事項；汽車產業「美國含量」原則極不公平，美國則反指加國後期新增中重型卡車關稅延展等訴求、翻燒餅式地反悔，格里爾稱華府給予加國「更優惠市場准入」，是加國拒簽導致破局。
廣東外語外貿大學加拿大研究中心研究員劉丹則指出，根本矛盾在美國，因出普要按「美國優先」重塑北美規則，加國象徵性讓步填不滿美方訴求。
美國既逼加國在關稅上退讓，又逼其在大國博弈中選邊，種子早在《USMCA》續簽僵局時已埋下。
單純看200億美元，未動能源、鉀肥、多數汽車零件，對兩國GDP直接衝擊有限。分析師預估，加國恐流失9萬崗位、GDP降0.3%—0.6%，美國則由進口商轉嫁物價、擾動中期選舉通膨敘事，但受傷的是魁北克乳業、安大略鋼鐵與家電、卑詩木材這些自由黨票倉企業，皇冠威士忌、鵝絨服、冰球裝備在美國零售端立刻變貴。
美國貿易官Ryan Majerus警告：「承壓的兩國都必須找脫身之計，但加國若也開徵，脫身會更難。」
加拿大商會主席Candace Laing直言，關稅戰對「整個北美競爭力是沉重打擊」。
真正的長尾成本在制度預期。《USMCA》原定2036年到期，2026年7月首次聯合審查後美方拒絕續簽16年，改採「逐年復審」，如今美加雙邊談崩、美墨雙邊續談，三邊框架實質退化為兩條雙邊軌道。
企業搭供應鏈週期經常超過10年，對此牛津經濟研究院預估，若USMCA體系瓦解疊加高關稅，10年恐令美國損失超1兆美元。此前，加美商業理事會預估，到2027年，美加分別有21.4萬與10.2萬職缺減少。
劉丹還指出，卡尼留了能源與關鍵礦產兩張牌，這正是川普對加重點訴求區，也是加國唯一能令華盛頓皺眉的槓桿。短期加國努力擴大亞洲歐洲替代不了72%對美出口依賴，但「去單一化」已寫入卡尼競選基因。
接下來走勢由兩個選舉鐘擺決定：美國期中選舉前若選民不在乎北美秩序破損，川普繼續「338條+鉛筆簽名」玩法；一旦通膨反噬選情，策略恐將調整。
在加國，則須考慮就業、反對黨攻勢與民意，因Abacus民調顯示74%民眾覺貿易爭端傷家計、僅18%支持讓步，請願驅逐美駐加大使簽近25萬，民調不允許卡尼回頭。
當338條這種百年冷門法條被喚醒，北美貿易的底層代碼就不再只是匯率與配額，而是「簽字用鉛筆還是用鋼印」的問題。
paras_en: At 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on Saturday (the 22nd), the United States officially imposed a 50% tariff on about $20 billion worth of Canadian goods under Section 338 of the 1930 Tariff Act, covering hundreds of specific products including red wine, beer, hockey sticks, cement, plywood, milk, and certain apparel.

A few hours later, Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau delivered a more than 20‑minute televised address to the nation, announcing a suspension of negotiations, the recall of the trade delegation, and a clear statement that from September 8th the U.S. would face equal retaliatory tariffs covering dairy, steel, household appliances, electronics, pulp and paper, and more.
Trudeau said, “When you are attacked, you are in a state of war—indeed we have been attacked. The United States has changed, and sometimes its signatures are written with a pencil.”

Negotiations had approached a conclusion. On August 18, Trump temporarily paused the tariffs for three days, and LeBron and U.S. Trade Representative Katherine Graham met in Washington for three days. Canada had offered to eliminate the digital services tax, loosen provincial bans on American wine, and reduce tolls on the Gordie Hawley Bridge, among other goodwill gestures. But on the afternoon of the 21st, the situation turned sharply: Graham frowned as she entered the meeting room, and a few hours later negotiations collapsed.

Trudeau blamed the U.S. for throwing three over‑the‑line provisions: limiting Canada’s ability to sign new trade agreements with third countries; interfering in sovereignty matters such as French language and cultural protection; and an unfair “U.S. content” rule in the automotive sector. The U.S. counter‑accused Canada of adding tariffs on medium‑heavy trucks later in the year and made a hasty reversal, while Graham claimed Washington offered Canada “more favorable market access,” which Canada rejected, leading to the breakdown.

Liu Dan, a researcher at Guangdong University of Foreign Studies’ Canadian Studies Center, pointed out that the fundamental conflict lies with the U.S., which insists on reshaping North American rules under a “U.S. first” mandate. Canada’s symbolic concessions failed to satisfy U.S. demands.
The U.S. forced Canada to concede on tariffs and to choose sides in a great‑power game, a seed that was already sown during the USMCA renewal stalemate.

Looking solely at the $20 billion, which excludes energy, potash, and most auto parts, the direct impact on both countries’ GDP is limited. Analysts estimate Canada could lose 90,000 jobs and see GDP fall by 0.3%–0.6%, while the U.S. would shift costs to importers, disrupt mid‑term election inflation narratives, and hurt Quebec dairy, Ontario steel and appliances, and British Columbia lumber—key Liberal‑vote‑bank businesses. Crown whisky, down‑feather coats, and hockey equipment would immediately become more expensive on the U.S. retail side.
U.S. trade official Ryan Majerus warned, “Both pressured countries must find a way out, but if Canada also imposes tariffs, it will be even harder to escape.”
Canadian Chamber of Commerce president Candace Laing bluntly said the tariff war is a heavy blow to “the entire North American competitiveness.”

The real long‑tail cost lies in institutional expectations. The USMCA was set to expire in 2036, but after the first joint review in July 2026, the U.S. rejected a 16‑year renewal and adopted a “year‑by‑year review” approach. Now, with U.S.–Canada talks collapsed, U.S.–Mexico and Canada–Mexico negotiations, the three‑party framework has effectively degraded into two bilateral tracks.

Companies’ supply‑chain cycles often exceed ten years. Oxford Economics estimates that if the USMCA system collapses and high tariffs are imposed, the U.S. could lose over $1 trillion in ten years. The U.S.–Canada Business Council previously estimated that by 2027, Canada and the U.S. would see 214,000 and 102,000 job losses, respectively.

Liu Dan also noted that Trudeau kept two cards—energy and critical minerals—which are exactly the areas Trump has focused on, and the only leverage Canada has to make Washington frown. In the short term, Canada’s efforts to expand Asian and European alternatives cannot replace its 72% dependence on U.S. exports, but “de‑single‑ling” has been written into Trudeau’s campaign DNA.

The next trajectory will be decided by two election clocks: if U.S. voters before the midterm elections do not care about a broken North American order, Trump will continue the “Section 338 + pencil‑signature” play; if inflation backlash affects the election, the strategy may shift.

In Canada, considerations include employment, opposition attacks, and public opinion. An Abacus poll shows 74% of people feel the trade dispute hurts household finances, while only 18% support concessions. Petitions have driven nearly 250,000 signatures for the U.S. ambassador in Canada, and the poll does not allow Trudeau to back down.

When a century‑old, rarely used provision like Section 338 is revived, the underlying code of North American trade is no longer just about exchange rates and quotas, but about whether signatures are made with a pencil or a steel‑stamp.

items.title: 7月行情再現？高盛：儲存股價獲利「落差大」最具吸引力  金融、黃金銅礦成新寵
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮近期出現新的變化。高盛(GS-US) 警告，AI交易開始出現裂痕，投資人需要留意部分AI相關股票的股價漲幅，已經與企業每股盈餘（EPS）表現出現越來越大的落差。與此同時，市場資金也開始轉向過去較少受到關注的領域，包括歐洲與日本銀行股、黃金礦商及銅礦股，都逐漸成為市場新的焦點。
高盛交易員Natasha Tiwana將上週行情形容為典型的「去槓桿行情」，市場跌勢之快，也讓原本認為7月股市拋售已經告一段落的投資人措手不及。
高盛高貝塔動量組合上週下跌12%，AI對沖組合5個交易日則下跌10%。
高盛指出，這次動量股大跌的原因，與7月行情有不少相似之處。雖然AI相關交易的槓桿程度已經從極端高點下降，但市場仍存在大量資金採取「逢低買進」策略，導致部分股票在下跌後迅速出現大量買盤。
不過，高盛認為，這波投資人調整持股、降低風險，搭配AI產業基本面仍然強勁，反而可能替市場9月重新承擔風險創造更健康的環境。

AI投資邏輯改變 儲存、資料中心成高盛首選

高盛認為，AI交易並沒有結束，但投資人現在關注的重點正在改變。
過去市場主要關注「哪些公司能從AI大規模資本支出中受惠」，如今隨著AI運算成本持續下降，投資人開始進一步尋找「哪些公司能真正從AI普及中賺到錢」。
在短線操作上，高盛建議投資人尋找股價表現與企業獲利之間存在明顯落差的股票。
其中，儲存與資料中心兩大板塊尤其受到高盛關注。高盛指出，這些公司的獲利預期已經改善，但股價似乎還沒有完全反映這些變化，因此存在戰術性投資機會。
接下來，輝達(NVDA-US) 第二季財報將成為市場重要觀察焦點，9月接連登場的產業會議，也可能進一步提供AI產業新的投資訊號。
另一方面，AI應用也開始受到更多關注。上週，莫德納(MRNA-US) 與默克藥廠(MRK-US) 宣布合作開發AI輔助藥物，帶動市場對AI醫療與AI藥物研發領域的興趣。
高盛數據顯示，醫療AI相關受惠企業的獲利預期正在改善，專業投資人的態度也開始轉趨正面，進一步吸引更多投資人關注AI藥物研發。

動量股正在換人！軟體取代半導體

高盛指出，市場熱門股的排名也正在快速洗牌。數據顯示，2026年動量因子單日跌幅超過5%的次數，已經超過過去5年的總和。
更值得注意的是，過去一年表現強勢的股票，與最近3個月強勢股的重疊程度已降至多年低點；反過來，過去一年強勢股與最近3個月弱勢股的重疊程度，卻接近歷史高點。
簡單來說，過去一年最熱門的股票，最近反而開始成為市場上的弱勢股。
從市場結構來看，軟體股已取代半導體，成為3個月動量多頭組合中權重最高的產業；半導體與AI相關股票則已轉向空頭組合，顯示市場正在尋找下一批領漲族群。

歐日銀行股崛起 高盛看好後市

高盛認為，市場重新評估聯準會（Fed）可能維持高利率更長時間後，歐洲與日本銀行股的吸引力正在提高。
除了利率環境之外，高盛也看好歐日銀行的其他收入來源，包括手續費收入成長、營運效率改善，以及股利與股票回購等股東回饋，都可能成為銀行股的支撐。
日本銀行股過去3個月已經同時跑贏東證指數與日本半導體類股，而且股價波動相對較低。高盛認為，黏性通膨與升息預期仍可能支持日本銀行股後市表現。
歐洲方面，整體銀行股目前相較美國銀行股仍有約15%的估值折價。
高盛最看好歐洲的希臘銀行股，認為相關銀行估值正在向歐元區核心國家的同業靠攏，但目前仍有約10%的折價，加上潛在併購題材，仍有進一步上漲空間。
值得注意的是，目前歐洲銀行股的投資人持股比例已降至兩年來低點，進一步強化了其配置價值。

黃金、銅礦股也有補漲機會

除了銀行股，高盛也看好黃金與銅等硬資產相關股票。
高盛先前就看好黃金礦商，理由包括中國需求回升，以及市場對聯準會降息的預期升溫。黃金礦商相關組合本月以來已上漲32%，但距離歷史高點仍有約12%的差距。目前本益比約11倍，仍比過去5年平均水準低約20%。
高盛認為，美國財政部擴大公債回購計畫可能推動美元走弱，進而成為黃金礦商下一階段上漲的推力。同時，地緣政治風險持續，也可能讓更多投資人將黃金視為年底前的避險工具。
銅市場同樣受到高盛關注。受到美國關稅風險，以及美國以外地區供應偏緊的支撐，銅價上週一度創下歷史新高。
不過，主要受到中東局勢升溫，以及市場資金過度集中AI交易的影響，銅礦股自2月以來的表現卻一直落後銅價，與其獲利基本面並不相稱。
高盛指出，從供需來看，銅市場仍受到供應緊張支撐；另一方面，7月聯準會會議紀要顯示，目前升息仍缺乏多數支持。如果市場重新預期聯準會政策轉向鴿派，工業金屬可能因此受惠，銅礦股也有機會追上銅價與企業獲利的表現。

高盛提醒：法國政治風險可能被市場低估

除了產業與資金輪動，高盛也提醒另一項市場風險：法國政治局勢。
今年夏季以來，市場看空法國國債的部位持續增加，法國與德國國債利差（OAT-Bund）已擴大至約85個基點，創下階段性新高。
不過，法國股市先前對政治風險的反應並不明顯，直到最近幾天才開始出現波動。
高盛認為，目前法國股市估值已經位於近5年90%分位的高檔，但市場尚未充分反映政治不確定性可能帶來的風險。
接下來幾項政治相關活動值得關注，包括8月27日法國企業主聯合會（Medef）夏季年會，以及8月30日司法部長Darmanin的夏季聚會。
從歷史經驗來看，法國國內股票對政治風險的反應比法國CAC 40指數更加敏感。一旦政治不確定性升高，相關股票與信用利差的連動也會更加明顯，意味著目前高檔估值可能面臨進一步修正壓力。
